source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ καθεξῆς καὶ αὐτὸς διώδευεν κατὰ πόλιν καὶ κώμην κηρύσσων καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ οἱ δώδεκα σὺν αὐτῷ, καὶ γυναῖκές τινες αἳ ἦσαν τεθεραπευμέναι ἀπὸ πνευμάτων πονηρῶν καὶ ἀσθενειῶν, Μαρία ἡ καλουμένη Μαγδαληνή, ἀφ’ ἧς δαιμόνια ἑπτὰ ἐξεληλύθει, καὶ Ἰωάννα γυνὴ Χουζᾶ ἐπιτρόπου Ἡρῴδου καὶ Σουσάννα καὶ ἕτεραι πολλαί, αἵτινες διηκόνουν αὐτοῖς ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐταῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And it came about in the [time] afterward that he was traveling through by city and village, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God, and the twelve with him, \v 2 and certain women who had been healed from spirits evil and sicknesses, Mary the [one] called Magdalene, from whom demons seven had gone out, \v 3 and Joanna wife of Chuza steward of Herod, and Susanna, and others many, who were serving them out of the possessions to them.

en.L: And it happened soon afterward that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was traveling through city after city and village, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God, and the twelve [were] with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 2 and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses: Mary, the one called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out, \v 3 and Joanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who were providing for them out of their own possessions.
en.B: Soon afterward Jesus went on through one town and village after another, preaching and announcing the good news of the kingdom of God. The twelve were with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 2 and so were some women who had been healed of evil spirits and diseases: Mary, called Magdalene, out of whom seven demons had gone; \v 3 Joanna, the wife of Herod's steward Chuza; Susanna; and many others. These women were using their own resources to provide for them.
en.R: After this, Jesus went through one town and village after another. He preached and told the good news about the kingdom of God. The twelve apostles went with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 2 Some women went too. Jesus had healed them from evil spirits and diseases. One was Mary, who was called Magdalene. Seven demons had come out of her. \v 3 Another was Joanna. Her husband Chuza managed the household of Herod the ruler. Susanna was there too, and many other women. They used their own money and belongings to take care of Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers.

es.L: Y sucedió poco después que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} iba recorriendo ciudad tras ciudad y aldea, predicando y anunciando la buena noticia del reino de Dios, y los doce [estaban] con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 2 y algunas mujeres que habían sido sanadas de espíritus malignos y de enfermedades: María, la llamada Magdalena, de la cual habían salido siete demonios, \v 3 y Juana, mujer de Cuza, administrador de Herodes, y Susana, y muchas otras, que les servían con sus propios bienes.
es.B: Poco después, Jesús fue recorriendo un pueblo y una aldea tras otra, predicando y anunciando la buena noticia del reino de Dios. Los Doce iban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 2 y también algunas mujeres que habían sido sanadas de espíritus malignos y de enfermedades: María, llamada Magdalena, de la que habían salido siete demonios; \v 3 Juana, esposa de Cuza, administrador de Herodes; Susana, y muchas otras. Estas mujeres los atendían con sus propios recursos.
es.R: Después de esto, Jesús fue de pueblo en pueblo y de aldea en aldea. Predicaba y contaba la buena noticia del reino de Dios. Los doce apóstoles iban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 2 También iban algunas mujeres. Jesús las había sanado de espíritus malignos y de enfermedades. Una de ellas era María, a la que llamaban Magdalena. De ella habían salido siete demonios. \v 3 Otra era Juana. Su esposo, Cuza, administraba la casa del gobernante Herodes. También estaba Susana, y muchas otras mujeres. Ellas usaban su propio dinero y sus bienes para atender a Jesús y a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos.

fr.L: Et il arriva, peu après, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parcourait ville après ville et village, prêchant et annonçant la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu, et les Douze [étaient] avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 2 ainsi que quelques femmes qui avaient été guéries d’esprits mauvais et de maladies : Marie, celle qu’on appelait la Magdaléenne, de qui sept démons étaient sortis, \v 3 et Jeanne, femme de Chouza, intendant d’Hérode, et Suzanne, et beaucoup d’autres, qui les assistaient de leurs biens.
fr.B: Peu après, Jésus alla de ville en ville et de village en village, prêchant et annonçant la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu. Les Douze étaient avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 2 ainsi que des femmes qui avaient été guéries d’esprits mauvais et de maladies : Marie de Magdala, de qui sept démons étaient sortis ; \v 3 Jeanne, femme de Chouza, l’intendant d’Hérode ; Suzanne ; et beaucoup d’autres. Ces femmes les assistaient de leurs propres ressources.
fr.R: Après cela, Jésus est passé par les villes et les villages, l’un après l’autre. Il prêchait et il annonçait la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu. Les douze apôtres {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accompagnaient. \v 2 Il y avait aussi des femmes. Jésus les avait guéries d’esprits mauvais et de maladies. L’une d’elles était Marie, qu’on appelait Marie de Magdala. Sept démons étaient sortis d’elle. \v 3 Il y avait aussi Jeanne. Son mari, Chouza, gérait la maison d’Hérode, le gouverneur. Suzanne était là aussi, et beaucoup d’autres femmes. Elles se servaient de leur argent et de leurs biens pour prendre soin de Jésus et de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivaient.

sw.L: Na ikawa muda mfupi baadaye {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alikuwa akipita mji kwa mji na kijiji, akihubiri na kutangaza habari njema za ufalme wa Mungu, na wale kumi na wawili [walikuwa] pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, \v 2 na wanawake fulani waliokuwa wameponywa kutoka kwa pepo wabaya na magonjwa: Mariamu, anayeitwa Magdalene, ambaye pepo saba walikuwa wametoka ndani yake, \v 3 na Yoana mke wa Kuza, msimamizi wa Herode, na Susana, na wengine wengi, ambao walikuwa wakiwahudumia kutokana na mali yao wenyewe.
sw.B: Muda mfupi baadaye Yesu alizunguka katika mji mmoja baada ya mwingine na kijiji kimoja baada ya kingine, akihubiri na kutangaza habari njema za ufalme wa Mungu. Wale Kumi na Wawili walikuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, \v 2 na pia wanawake kadhaa waliokuwa wameponywa kutoka kwa pepo wabaya na magonjwa: Mariamu, anayeitwa Magdalene, ambaye pepo saba walikuwa wametoka ndani yake; \v 3 Yoana, mke wa Kuza, msimamizi wa Herode; Susana; na wengine wengi. Wanawake hao walikuwa wakiwahudumia kwa kutumia mali yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, Yesu alipita katika miji na vijiji vingi, kimoja baada ya kingine. Alihubiri na kuwaeleza watu habari njema za ufalme wa Mungu. Mitume kumi na wawili walikwenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. \v 2 Wanawake fulani pia walikwenda pamoja nao. Yesu alikuwa amewaweka huru kutoka kwa pepo wabaya na kuwaponya magonjwa yao. Mmoja wao alikuwa Mariamu, aliyeitwa Magdalene. Pepo saba walikuwa wametoka ndani yake. \v 3 Mwingine alikuwa Yoana. Mume wake, Kuza, alisimamia nyumba ya mtawala Herode. Susana pia alikuwako, na wanawake wengine wengi. Walitumia fedha na mali zao wenyewe kumhudumia Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 이런 일이 있었다. 그분은 고을과 마을을 두루 다니시며 하나님의 나라를 선포하시고 복음을 전하셨는데, 열둘이 그분과 함께 있었다. \v 2 또 악한 영들과 병에서 고침을 받은 몇몇 여자들, 곧 일곱 귀신이 나간 막달라 여자라고 불리는 마리아와 \v 3 헤롯의 청지기 구사의 아내 요안나와 수산나와 그 밖의 많은 여자들도 [함께 있었다]. 그들은 자기들의 재산으로 그들을 섬기고 있었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 예수께서는 여러 고을과 마을을 두루 다니시며 하나님의 나라를 선포하시고 그 복음을 전하셨다. 열두 제자도 예수와 함께 다녔다. \v 2 악한 영들과 병에서 고침을 받은 여자들도 몇 사람 함께 있었다. 일곱 귀신이 나간 막달라 여자 마리아와, \v 3 헤롯의 청지기 구사의 아내 요안나와, 수산나와, 그 밖의 여러 여자들이었다. 이 여자들은 자기 재산으로 예수의 일행을 뒷바라지했다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 예수께서는 이 마을 저 마을을 다니셨다. 예수께서는 하나님의 나라에 대한 기쁜 소식을 전하셨다. 열두 제자도 예수와 함께 다녔다. \v 2 여자들 몇 사람도 함께 다녔다. 예수께서 그들에게서 악한 영들을 쫓아내시고 병을 고쳐 주셨던 여자들이었다. 그 가운데 한 사람은 막달라 마을에서 온 마리아였다. 마리아에게서는 귀신이 일곱이나 나갔다. \v 3 또 요안나도 있었다. 요안나의 남편 구사는 통치자 헤롯의 집안일을 맡아보던 관리였다. 수산나도 있었고, 그 밖에 다른 여자들도 많이 있었다. 이 여자들은 자기들의 돈과 물건으로 예수와 제자들을 돌보았다.

vi.L: Và xảy ra là ngay sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi qua từng thành và từng làng, rao giảng và rao truyền Tin Lành về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời, và [nhóm] Mười Hai [ở] với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 2 và mấy người phụ nữ đã được chữa lành khỏi các ác linh và bệnh tật: Ma-ri, người được gọi là Ma-đơ-len, là người đã có bảy quỷ ra khỏi, \v 3 và Gian-nơ, vợ của Chu-xa, quản gia của Hê-rốt, và Su-xan-nơ, và nhiều người khác nữa, là những người đã lấy của cải riêng mình mà phục vụ họ.
vi.B: Sau đó, Đức Giê-xu đi khắp các thành và các làng, rao giảng và rao truyền Tin Lành về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời. Nhóm Mười Hai cùng đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 2 và cũng có mấy người phụ nữ đã được chữa lành khỏi các ác linh và bệnh tật: Ma-ri, gọi là Ma-đơ-len, người đã được bảy quỷ ra khỏi; \v 3 Gian-nơ, vợ của Chu-xa, quản gia của Hê-rốt; Su-xan-nơ; và nhiều người khác. Những phụ nữ này lấy của cải riêng của mình mà giúp đỡ họ.
vi.R: Sau đó, Đức Giê-xu đi qua hết thành này đến làng khác. Ngài rao giảng và loan báo Tin Lành về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời. Mười hai môn đồ cùng đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 2 Cũng có mấy người phụ nữ đi theo. Đức Giê-xu đã chữa cho họ khỏi tà linh và bệnh tật. Một người là Ma-ri, người được gọi là Ma-đơ-len. Bảy quỷ đã ra khỏi bà. \v 3 Một người khác là Gian-nơ. Chồng bà là Chu-xa, người quản lý nhà cửa của vua Hê-rốt. Cũng có Su-xan-nơ và nhiều phụ nữ khác nữa. Họ dùng tiền bạc và của cải riêng của mình để lo cho Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: them: Jesus and the twelve, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: him: Jesus alone, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "him", which makes the women's service center on Jesus, as in Matthew 27:55 and Mark 15:41. Others, including several early ones, read "them", which includes the twelve who traveled with him. The scribes may have changed "them" to "him" to match the other Gospels. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: were providing for: supplying their needs
decisions.reason: The verb is used of serving a meal (4:39) and of meeting someone's needs. Here the women meet the needs of the group out of their own property.

decisions.choice: Chuza, Herod's steward: an official who managed the property or household of Herod Antipas, ruler of Galilee
decisions.reason: This Herod ruled Galilee (3:1). A steward managed his master's estate or affairs (Matthew 20:8). Joanna, from a household close to the ruler, appears again at the empty tomb (24:10).

decisions.choice: Magdalene: probably from Magdala, a town on the western shore of the Lake of Galilee
decisions.reason: The word describes where she came from and tells her apart from other women named Mary. Mark 16:9 also says that seven demons had been driven out of her.

decisions.choice: had been healed: healed by Jesus
decisions.reason: The passive does not name the healer, but Luke has just told of Jesus healing many who had diseases and evil spirits (4:40-41; 7:21).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: apostles; Jesus had healed them; Jesus and his followers
alternatives: the twelve; who had been healed; them
decisions.reason: Readable names the twelve as Luke did at 6:13, says who healed the women, as the meaning decision explains, and says who "them" were.

decisions.choice: anunciando la buena noticia del reino de Dios (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words, recorded once in this chapter: "el reino de Dios", and "la buena noticia" for the Greek verb "to announce good news". "Evangelio" is kept for the noun where it names the message; here Luke describes the act of announcing it.

decisions.choice: discípulos (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "his followers". The term sheet keeps "discípulos" at every level, a word every Spanish reader knows; the same in verses 9 and 22.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Luke's historic presents kept as presents at Literal ("arrive quelqu’un", 8:49)
decisions.reason: As in John and Mark: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and as young readers now meet stories. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: annoncer la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu; les Douze (L, B)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms for the Gospels: "la bonne nouvelle du royaume" at every level where the English says "good news", "le royaume de Dieu" at every level, and "les Douze" capitalised as the name of the group. Readable says "les douze apôtres", as the English does.

decisions.choice: la Magdaléenne (L); Marie de Magdala (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the epithet as an adjective ("la Magdaléenne"); Balanced and Readable say "Marie de Magdala", which shows that the name comes from her town (m4), avoiding "Madeleine", which later tradition burdened with other stories. Balanced and Readable match Mark 15:40 and 16:1.

decisions.choice: kutangaza habari njema za ufalme wa Mungu (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words, recorded once in this chapter: "ufalme wa Mungu", and "habari njema" for the Greek verb "to announce good news". "Injili" is kept for the noun where it names the message; here Luke describes the act of announcing it.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "his followers". The term sheet keeps "wanafunzi" at every level, the everyday word for a teacher's disciples; the same in verses 9 and 22.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Luke 8; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시-, Jesus speaks in 해라체, people speak to him in 합쇼체, and the demons speak to him in 합쇼체 with "당신"
alternatives: Korean spans for pronouns referring to Jesus
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (Korean style guide, sections 4 and 7); the speech levels are those settled for the Korean Gospels.

decisions.choice: "선포하다" (L, B) for kēryssō and "복음을 전하다" (L, B), "기쁜 소식을 전하다" (R) for euangelizomai; "열둘" (L), "열두 제자" (B, R); "악한 영" at every level for Luke's "evil spirits"
decisions.reason: The verbs follow Luke 4:43-44 and Mark in Korean. The Twelve are named as in the Korean Mark. Luke here says "evil" spirits, not "unclean" ones, so "악한 영" stands at Literal and Balanced too; "더러운 영" is kept for 8:29.

decisions.choice: "막달라 여자라고 불리는 마리아" (L); "막달라 여자 마리아" (B); "막달라 마을에서 온 마리아" (R); "요안나", "구사", "헤롯", "수산나"; "청지기" (L, B) for epitropos
decisions.reason: Protestant forms of the names (style guide, section 5). Literal keeps "called"; the meaning decision takes Magdalene as "from Magdala", which Readable says. "청지기" is the usual word for one who manages a household's property; Readable says what he did.

decisions.choice: "[nhóm] Mười Hai" (L); "nhóm Mười Hai" (B); "Mười hai môn đồ" (R) for the twelve
decisions.reason: The settled forms for the Twelve in the Gospels, as in Mark 4:10. The English Readable says "apostles"; Vietnamese Readable keeps "môn đồ", the word new readers meet throughout the Gospels.

decisions.choice: "ác linh" (L, B); "tà linh" (R) for the evil spirits; "Ma-đơ-len", "Gian-nơ", "Chu-xa", "Su-xan-nơ"
decisions.reason: Luke's word here is "evil", not "unclean", so Literal and Balanced say "ác linh" and keep "linh ô uế" for the unclean spirits (8:29); Readable uses "tà linh" for both, as Mark's Readable does. The names follow the Protestant transliterations; a reviewer may prefer the newer "Gian-na", "Su-xan-na".

source.text: Συνιόντος δὲ ὄχλου πολλοῦ καὶ τῶν κατὰ πόλιν ἐπιπορευομένων πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπεν διὰ παραβολῆς·

records.literal_gloss: Coming together now a crowd great and those by city journeying to him, he spoke through a parable:

en.L: Now as a large crowd was gathering and those from city after city were journeying to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke by means of a parable:
en.B: A large crowd was gathering, and people from town after town kept coming to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He told them a parable:
en.R: A large crowd was coming together. People from many towns were coming to Jesus. He told them a parable, a story that teaches a lesson:

es.L: Y como se reunía una gran multitud, y los de ciudad tras ciudad acudían a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, dijo por medio de una parábola:
es.B: Se estaba reuniendo una gran multitud, y de pueblo en pueblo la gente acudía a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces les contó una parábola:
es.R: Una gran multitud se estaba juntando. Gente de muchos pueblos venía a ver a Jesús. Él les contó una parábola, una historia que enseña una lección:

fr.L: Or, comme une grande foule se rassemblait et que ceux de ville en ville se rendaient auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parla au moyen d’une parabole :
fr.B: Une grande foule se rassemblait, et de ville en ville des gens ne cessaient de venir à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il leur dit cette parabole :
fr.R: Une grande foule se réunissait. Des gens venaient voir Jésus depuis beaucoup de villes. Il leur a raconté une parabole, c’est-à-dire une histoire qui enseigne une leçon :

sw.L: Na umati mkubwa ulipokuwa ukikusanyika, na wale wa mji kwa mji walipokuwa wakimjia, alisema kwa mfano:
sw.B: Umati mkubwa ulikuwa ukikusanyika, na watu kutoka mji mmoja baada ya mwingine walikuwa wakimjia. Naye akawaambia mfano huu:
sw.R: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa ukikusanyika. Watu kutoka miji mingi walikuwa wakija kwa Yesu. Aliwaambia mfano, yaani hadithi inayofundisha somo:

ko.L: 많은 무리가 모여들고 고을마다 사람들이 그분께로 오고 있을 때에, 그분은 비유로 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 많은 무리가 모여들고 여러 고을에서 사람들이 예수께로 계속 몰려오자, 예수께서 비유를 들어 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 많은 사람들이 모여들었다. 여러 마을에서 사람들이 예수께 왔다. 예수께서 그들에게 비유를 들어 말씀하셨다. 비유는 삶에서 흔히 보는 일로 하나님의 뜻을 가르치는 이야기이다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ, khi một đoàn dân rất đông đang tụ họp, và những người từ thành này đến thành khác đang kéo đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dùng một ngụ ngôn mà nói:
vi.B: Một đoàn dân rất đông đang tụ họp, và người ta từ các thành cứ kéo đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài kể cho họ một ngụ ngôn:
vi.R: Một đám đông rất lớn tụ họp lại. Người ta từ nhiều thành phố kéo đến với Đức Giê-xu. Ngài kể cho họ một câu chuyện để dạy họ:

decisions.choice: parable: a comparison or story from everyday life that teaches about God and his kingdom
decisions.reason: The word means setting one thing beside another. Luke uses it for short sayings (4:23; 5:36; 6:39) and for stories like this one, whose meaning Jesus explains to his disciples (8:11-15).

decisions.choice: as a large crowd was gathering: the scene in which the parable is told
decisions.reason: The participles describe the crowd still coming together. A story about different kinds of hearers is told to a large and mixed crowd.

decisions.choice: Jesus; a story that teaches a lesson
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus and explains the word "parable".

decisions.choice: parábola (every level); "una historia que enseña una lección" added at Readable
decisions.reason: "Parábola" is the term-sheet word, the one Spanish readers know for these stories (meaning decision m1). Here the English Readable keeps "parable" and explains it, so Readable does the same.

decisions.choice: une parabole, c’est-à-dire une histoire qui enseigne une leçon (R)
alternatives: une histoire, as Readable in Mark 4
decisions.reason: English Readable keeps the word "parable" in Luke and explains it, and 8:9-10 go on to use it; Readable French does the same, so the word stays the same through the chapter.

decisions.choice: mfano (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet word. "Mfano" is a comparison or picture-story (meaning decision m1); "fumbo" is a riddle. Readable adds what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "비유" at every level, explained once at Readable
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4 and Luke 5:36 in Korean, "비유" is kept at every level so 8:9-11 stays linked; Readable explains it once here, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ngụ ngôn" (L, B); "câu chuyện để dạy họ" (R) for the parable (whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The settled word for Jesus' parables at Literal and Balanced, as in Mark 4:2; Readable says "câu chuyện" for a story told to teach, as Mark's Readable does, and adds what it is for, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Narrator "Ngài" for Jesus; Jesus says "Ta" and "các con" to the disciples; they call him "Thầy" and themselves "chúng con" (whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The forms of address the style guide (section 6) sets for the Gospels, kept as in Luke 4-6 and Mark 4-5.

source.text: Ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων τοῦ σπεῖραι τὸν σπόρον αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Went out the [one] sowing to sow the seed of him.

en.L: "The sower went out to sow his seed.
en.B: "A sower went out to scatter his seed.
en.R: "A farmer went out to his field to plant seeds.

es.L: «Salió el sembrador a sembrar su semilla.
es.B: «Un sembrador salió a esparcir su semilla.
es.R: «Un agricultor fue a su campo a sembrar semillas.

fr.L: « Le semeur est sorti pour semer sa semence.
fr.B: « Un semeur est sorti pour répandre sa semence.
fr.R: « Un paysan est allé dans son champ pour planter des graines.

sw.L: "Mpandaji alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.
sw.B: "Mpandaji mmoja alitoka kwenda kutawanya mbegu zake.
sw.R: "Mkulima mmoja alikwenda shambani kwake kupanda mbegu.

ko.L: "씨 뿌리는 사람이 자기 씨를 뿌리러 나갔다.
ko.B: "씨 뿌리는 사람이 씨를 뿌리러 나갔다.
ko.R: "한 농부가 씨를 뿌리러 밭에 나갔다.

vi.L: "Người gieo giống đi ra để gieo hạt giống của mình.
vi.B: "Có một người nông dân đi ra gieo giống.
vi.R: "Có một người nông dân ra đồng gieo hạt.

decisions.choice: sowing: scattering seed by hand across a field
alternatives: planting seeds one by one in rows
decisions.reason: Grain was sown by throwing handfuls of seed over the ground. That is why some of it could land on a path, on rock, or among thorns.

decisions.choice: the sower: a figure in the story, not a particular person
decisions.reason: The article marks a typical figure: any sower. In his explanation Jesus does not say who the sower is; the story is about the seed and the ground (8:11-15).

decisions.choice: a sower ... to scatter (B); a farmer ... to plant seeds (R)
alternatives: a farmer went out to sow his seed
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the figure of the sower and uses "scatter" for the way seed was sown, as the meaning decision explains. Readable uses everyday words and supplies "to his field".

decisions.choice: the parable told in the passé composé at every level ("est sorti", "est tombée")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The parable is Jesus's spoken words, and French speech tells past events in the passé composé, as the style guide asks and as Mark 4 does; the passé simple would turn his telling into written narration.

decisions.choice: "씨 뿌리는 사람" (L, B); "농부" (R), as in Mark 4:3
decisions.reason: The synoptic parallel reads alike in Korean.

decisions.choice: "người nông dân" (B, R) for the sower
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:3: the sower is any farmer in the story (meaning decision); Literal keeps "người gieo giống".

source.text: καὶ ἐν τῷ σπείρειν αὐτὸν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ κατεπατήθη καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατέφαγεν αὐτό.

records.literal_gloss: And in the sowing [of] him, some fell beside the road, and it was trampled down, and the birds of the heaven devoured it.

en.L: And as he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled down, and the birds of the sky ate it up.
en.B: As he sowed, some of the seed dropped beside the road, where it was stepped on, and the birds swallowed it up.
en.R: As he threw the seed, some of it fell on the path. People stepped on it, and birds ate it all.

es.L: Y mientras sembraba, una [parte] cayó junto al camino, y fue pisoteada, y las aves del cielo la devoraron.
es.B: Mientras sembraba, parte de la semilla cayó junto al camino; allí la pisotearon, y los pájaros se la tragaron.
es.R: Mientras echaba la semilla, una parte cayó en el sendero. La gente la pisó, y los pájaros se la comieron toda.

fr.L: Et pendant qu’il semait, une partie est tombée le long du chemin, et elle a été piétinée, et les oiseaux du ciel l’ont dévorée.
fr.B: Pendant qu’il semait, une partie de la semence est tombée au bord du chemin, où on l’a piétinée, et les oiseaux l’ont avalée.
fr.R: Pendant qu’il lançait les graines, certaines sont tombées sur le chemin. Des gens ont marché dessus, et des oiseaux les ont toutes mangées.

sw.L: Na alipokuwa akipanda, [mbegu] nyingine ilianguka kando ya njia, ikakanyagwa, na ndege wa angani wakaila.
sw.B: Alipokuwa akipanda, baadhi ya mbegu zilianguka kando ya njia, zikakanyagwa, nao ndege wakazila zote.
sw.R: Alipokuwa akirusha mbegu, nyingine zilianguka njiani. Watu walizikanyaga, na ndege wakazila zote.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 씨를 뿌릴 때에 어떤 것은 길가에 떨어져 밟혔고, 하늘의 새들이 그것을 먹어 버렸다.
ko.B: 그가 씨를 뿌리는데, 어떤 씨는 길가에 떨어져서 사람들에게 밟히고, 새들이 쪼아 먹어 버렸다.
ko.R: 농부가 씨를 뿌릴 때, 어떤 씨는 길 위에 떨어졌다. 사람들이 그 씨를 밟고 지나갔다. 그리고 새들이 와서 다 먹어 버렸다.

vi.L: Và trong khi người ấy gieo, có [hạt] rơi dọc theo lối đi, và bị giẫm lên, và chim trời ăn nuốt hết.
vi.B: Trong khi người ấy rải hạt, có một số hạt rơi bên lối đi, bị người ta giẫm lên, và chim trời ăn mất.
vi.R: Khi người ấy rải hạt, có một số hạt rơi trên lối đi. Người ta giẫm lên, và chim bay đến ăn hết.

decisions.choice: the road: a path along or through the field, packed hard by people walking on it
decisions.reason: Seed that lands on a beaten path cannot sink into the soil. It lies on top, where feet crush it and birds find it.

decisions.choice: the birds of the heaven: wild birds
decisions.reason: "Heaven" here means the sky. The phrase is a common way of speaking of wild birds (Genesis 1:26; Psalm 104:12).

decisions.choice: People stepped on it
decisions.reason: Readable names who trampled it, so that the sentence can be active.

decisions.choice: "사람들에게 밟히고" (B)
decisions.reason: Korean says who trampled it where the passive alone sounds unfinished; the English Readable supplies "people" too.

decisions.choice: "chim trời" (L, B); "chim" (R)
decisions.reason: "Chim trời" is the everyday Vietnamese phrase for wild birds and keeps the Greek "birds of the heaven" (meaning decision) without sounding foreign.

source.text: καὶ ἕτερον κατέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν, καὶ φυὲν ἐξηράνθη διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ἰκμάδα.

records.literal_gloss: And other fell down upon the rock, and having grown it withered because of the not having moisture.

en.L: And other [seed] fell down on the rock, and when it had grown up, it withered because it had no moisture.
en.B: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it sprouted it shriveled, because the ground held no moisture.
en.R: Some seed fell where there was rock under the soil. The plants came up, but they soon dried up because they had no water.

es.L: Y otra [parte] cayó sobre la roca, y al brotar se secó, por no tener humedad.
es.B: Otra parte cayó sobre la roca, y en cuanto brotó se marchitó, porque el suelo no tenía humedad.
es.R: Otra parte cayó donde había roca debajo de la tierra. Las plantas salieron, pero pronto se secaron porque no tenían agua.

fr.L: Et une autre [partie] est tombée sur la roche, et, après avoir poussé, elle s’est desséchée, parce qu’elle n’avait pas d’humidité.
fr.B: Une autre partie est tombée sur la roche ; à peine levée, elle s’est desséchée, parce que le sol manquait d’humidité.
fr.R: D’autres graines sont tombées à un endroit où il y avait de la roche sous la terre. Les plantes ont poussé, mais elles ont vite séché, parce qu’elles n’avaient pas d’eau.

sw.L: Na nyingine ilianguka juu ya mwamba, na ilipoota ikanyauka kwa sababu ya kutokuwa na unyevu.
sw.B: Nyingine ilianguka juu ya mwamba, na mara ilipochipuka ikanyauka, kwa sababu ardhi haikuwa na unyevu.
sw.R: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka mahali ambapo chini ya udongo kulikuwa na mwamba. Mimea iliota, lakini punde ikakauka kwa sababu haikuwa na maji.

ko.L: 그리고 다른 것은 바위 위에 떨어졌는데, 자라나자 말라 버렸다. 습기가 없었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 어떤 씨는 바위 위에 떨어졌는데, 싹이 나자마자 말라 버렸다. 땅에 물기가 없었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 어떤 씨는 흙 밑에 바위가 있는 곳에 떨어졌다. 싹이 나왔지만 곧 말라 버렸다. 물기가 없었기 때문이다.

vi.L: Và [hạt] khác rơi xuống trên đá, và khi đã mọc lên thì khô héo, vì không có hơi ẩm.
vi.B: Có hạt khác rơi trên đất đá; vừa mọc lên đã khô héo, vì đất không có hơi ẩm.
vi.R: Có hạt rơi trên chỗ có đá nằm ngay dưới lớp đất. Cây non mọc lên, nhưng chẳng bao lâu thì khô héo, vì không có nước.

decisions.choice: the rock: bedrock with only a thin layer of soil over it
decisions.reason: Mark 4:5 says this ground did not have much soil. Seed in shallow soil over rock sprouts quickly but cannot put roots down to find water (8:13).

decisions.choice: because it had no moisture: the reason it withered
alternatives: because of the heat of the sun
decisions.reason: Luke names the lack of moisture; Mark 4:6 adds the sun. Both come from the shallow soil.

decisions.choice: the ground held no moisture (B); rock under the soil ... no water (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say where the moisture was lacking, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "바위" (L, B); "흙 밑에 바위가 있는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke says "the rock", not Mark's "rocky ground"; Literal and Balanced keep Luke's word, and Readable says what it means (meaning decision).

source.text: καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀκανθῶν, καὶ συμφυεῖσαι αἱ ἄκανθαι ἀπέπνιξαν αὐτό.

records.literal_gloss: And other fell in [the] middle of the thorns, and having grown up with [it] the thorns choked it.

en.L: And other [seed] fell in the midst of the thorns, and the thorns, growing up with [it], choked it.
en.B: Other seed landed among thornbushes, which sprang up with it and smothered it.
en.R: Some seed fell among thorny weeds. The weeds grew up too, and they choked the young plants.

es.L: Y otra [parte] cayó en medio de los espinos, y los espinos, creciendo junto [con ella], la ahogaron.
es.B: Otra parte cayó entre espinos, que crecieron junto con ella y la sofocaron.
es.R: Otra parte de la semilla cayó entre hierbas con espinas. Esas hierbas también crecieron y ahogaron las plantas nuevas.

fr.L: Et une autre est tombée au milieu des épines, et les épines, poussant avec [elle], l’ont étouffée.
fr.B: Une autre partie est tombée parmi les ronces, qui ont poussé avec elle et l’ont étouffée.
fr.R: D’autres graines sont tombées au milieu de mauvaises herbes pleines d’épines. Ces herbes ont poussé aussi, et elles ont étouffé les jeunes plantes.

sw.L: Na nyingine ilianguka katikati ya miiba, na miiba, ikiota pamoja [nayo], ikaisonga.
sw.B: Nyingine ilianguka kati ya miiba, nayo miiba ikaota pamoja nayo, ikaisonga.
sw.R: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kati ya magugu yenye miiba. Magugu hayo yalikua pia, yakaisonga mimea michanga.

ko.L: 그리고 다른 것은 가시덤불 한가운데 떨어졌는데, 가시덤불이 함께 자라나서 그것을 숨 막히게 했다.
ko.B: 어떤 씨는 가시덤불 속에 떨어졌는데, 가시덤불이 함께 자라서 싹을 짓눌러 버렸다.
ko.R: 어떤 씨는 가시덤불 사이에 떨어졌다. 가시덤불도 함께 자랐다. 그래서 가시덤불이 어린 싹들을 덮어 버렸다.

vi.L: Và [hạt] khác rơi vào giữa bụi gai, và gai cùng mọc lên làm nghẹt nó.
vi.B: Có hạt khác rơi vào giữa bụi gai; gai mọc lên cùng với nó và làm nghẹt nó.
vi.R: Có hạt rơi giữa đám cỏ gai. Cỏ gai cũng mọc lên và chèn ép các cây non.

decisions.choice: thorns: thorny weeds or bushes already rooted in the soil
alternatives: thorns lying loose on the ground
decisions.reason: The thorns grow up together with the seed, so their roots were already there. They take the light, water and room the young plants need.

decisions.choice: choked: smothered, so that it could not grow
decisions.reason: The verb means to choke or strangle. The explanation uses a related verb for people choked by worries and riches (8:14).

decisions.choice: the young plants
decisions.reason: Readable says what the weeds choked.

source.text: καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν, καὶ φυὲν ἐποίησεν καρπὸν ἑκατονταπλασίονα.

records.literal_gloss: And other fell into the soil the good, and having grown it produced fruit a hundredfold.

en.L: And other [seed] fell into the good soil, and when it had grown up, it produced fruit a hundredfold."
en.B: And other seed dropped into good soil, sprang up, and produced a hundredfold harvest."
en.R: But some seed fell on good soil. It grew well and produced a hundred times as much grain as was planted."

es.L: Y otra [parte] cayó en la tierra buena, y al brotar produjo fruto al ciento por uno».
es.B: Y otra parte cayó en buena tierra, brotó y dio una cosecha del ciento por uno».
es.R: Pero otra parte de la semilla cayó en tierra buena. Creció bien y dio cien veces más grano del que se había sembrado».

fr.L: Et une autre est tombée dans la bonne terre, et, après avoir poussé, elle a produit du fruit au centuple. »
fr.B: Une autre partie, enfin, est tombée dans la bonne terre ; elle a levé et a donné une récolte au centuple. »
fr.R: Mais d’autres graines sont tombées dans de la bonne terre. Elles ont bien poussé, et elles ont donné cent fois plus de grain qu’on en avait planté. »

sw.L: Na nyingine ilianguka katika udongo mzuri, na ilipoota ikazaa matunda mara mia."
sw.B: Na nyingine ilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri, ikaota, ikatoa mavuno mara mia."
sw.R: Lakini mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri. Zilikua vizuri, zikatoa nafaka mara mia ya zile zilizopandwa."

ko.L: 그리고 다른 것은 좋은 땅에 떨어졌는데, 자라나서 백 배의 열매를 맺었다."
ko.B: 그리고 어떤 씨는 좋은 땅에 떨어졌다. 그 씨는 싹이 나고 자라서 백 배의 열매를 맺었다."
ko.R: 그러나 어떤 씨는 좋은 땅에 떨어졌다. 그 씨는 잘 자라서 뿌린 것보다 백 배나 많은 곡식을 냈다."

vi.L: Và [hạt] khác rơi vào đất tốt, và khi đã mọc lên thì sinh trái gấp một trăm."
vi.B: Có hạt khác rơi vào đất tốt, mọc lên và sinh hoa lợi gấp trăm lần."
vi.R: Nhưng có hạt rơi vào đất tốt. Cây lớn lên tốt và cho số hạt gấp một trăm lần số hạt đã gieo."

decisions.choice: a hundredfold: a very large harvest
decisions.reason: A hundredfold harvest was a sign of great blessing: Isaac reaped a hundredfold in the year of famine, because the LORD blessed him (Genesis 26:12).

decisions.choice: fruit: the crop, the grain the plant produces
decisions.reason: The word is used of any crop. The explanation turns it into a picture of a life that does what the word says (8:15).

decisions.choice: a hundred times as much grain as was planted
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "a hundredfold" means.

decisions.choice: "열매" (L, B); "곡식" (R) for karpos, as in Mark 4:7-8
decisions.reason: "열매를 맺다" keeps the word Jesus uses again of people in 8:14-15; Readable names the crop.

source.text: ταῦτα λέγων ἐφώνει· Ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

records.literal_gloss: These things saying, he was calling out: The [one] having ears to hear let him hear.

en.L: Saying these things, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called out, "The one who has ears to hear, let {{gender:them|him}} hear."
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called out, "Whoever has ears to hear should listen!"
en.R: Then Jesus called out, "Everyone who has ears to hear should listen carefully!"

es.L: Diciendo estas cosas, exclamaba: «El que tiene oídos para oír, que oiga».
es.B: Mientras decía esto, exclamó: «¡Quien tenga oídos para oír, que escuche!».
es.R: Luego Jesús dijo en voz alta: «¡Todo el que tenga oídos para oír, que escuche con atención!».

fr.L: Disant cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’écriait : « Celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre, qu’il entende ! »
fr.B: En disant cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’écria : « Qui a des oreilles pour entendre, qu’il écoute ! »
fr.R: Puis Jésus a dit d’une voix forte : « Que tous ceux qui ont des oreilles pour entendre écoutent bien ! »

sw.L: Akisema mambo haya, alikuwa akipaza sauti, "Aliye na masikio ya kusikia, na asikie."
sw.B: Alipokuwa akisema hayo, alipaza sauti, "Yeyote mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikilize!"
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alipaza sauti, "Kila mwenye masikio ya kusikia na asikilize kwa makini!"

ko.L: 이것들을 말씀하시면서 그분은 크게 외치셨다. "들을 귀가 있는 사람은 들어라."
ko.B: 예수께서는 이 말씀을 하시고 큰 소리로 외치셨다. "들을 귀가 있는 사람은 잘 들어라."
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 큰 소리로 말씀하셨다. "귀가 있으면 잘 들어라!"

vi.L: Khi nói những điều ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kêu lớn: "Ai có tai để nghe, hãy nghe."
vi.B: Nói xong điều ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kêu lớn: "Ai có tai để nghe thì hãy lắng nghe!"
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói lớn: "Ai có tai thì hãy nghe cho kỹ!"

decisions.choice: the one who has ears to hear, let him hear: everyone able to hear should pay attention and take this to heart
alternatives: a remark about people who are deaf
decisions.reason: Jesus calls his hearers to listen with understanding, not only with their ears (14:35). The whole parable is about how people hear (8:18).

decisions.choice: called out: raised his voice
decisions.reason: The verb means to call aloud. Jesus says the closing words loudly so that the whole crowd hears the warning.

decisions.choice: Whoever has ears to hear should listen
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the third-person command in a form that speaks of anyone, without a pronoun.

decisions.choice: no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "him" as a traditional alternative. Spanish "el que" and "que oiga" already speak of anyone, so the setting has nothing to change, here and in verse 18.

decisions.choice: no gender span: « Celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre, qu’il entende »
alternatives: a gender setting on "il", as the English "them|him"
decisions.reason: In French "celui qui" and the "il" that refers back to it are ordinary generic French and already include everyone, so the style guide adds no span. The same holds for "celui qui a … il lui sera donné" in 8:18.

decisions.choice: no gender spans
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "him" as a traditional alternative, but "aliye" and "asikie" say nothing about sex, so the setting has nothing to change, here and in verse 18.

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span (also 8:18), where the English has {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" and "누구든지" already include men and women, and the command needs no pronoun, as in Mark 4:9 (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "ai" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:9: "ai" (whoever) is already inclusive, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart.

source.text: Ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ τίς αὕτη εἴη ἡ παραβολή.

records.literal_gloss: Were asking then him the disciples of him what this might be the parable.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples were asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} what this parable might mean.
en.B: His disciples asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} what this parable meant.
en.R: His disciples asked Jesus what this parable meant.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaban qué querría decir esta parábola.
es.B: Sus discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron qué significaba esta parábola.
es.R: Sus discípulos le preguntaron a Jesús qué significaba esa parábola.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandaient ce que pouvait signifier cette parabole.
fr.B: Ses disciples {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent ce que voulait dire cette parabole.
fr.R: Ses disciples ont demandé à Jésus ce que cette parabole voulait dire.

sw.L: Na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa wakimwuliza mfano huu ungekuwa na maana gani.
sw.B: Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walimwuliza maana ya mfano huo.
sw.R: Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walimwuliza Yesu maana ya mfano huo.

ko.L: 그러자 그분의 제자들이 이 비유가 무엇인지 그분께 묻고 있었다.
ko.B: 제자들이 이 비유가 무슨 뜻인지 예수께 여쭈었다.
ko.R: 제자들이 예수께 이 비유가 무슨 뜻인지 여쭈었다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngụ ngôn này có nghĩa là gì.
vi.B: Các môn đồ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngụ ngôn ấy có nghĩa là gì.
vi.R: Các môn đồ hỏi Đức Giê-xu câu chuyện ấy có nghĩa là gì.

decisions.choice: what this parable might be: what it meant
alternatives: what kind of story it was
decisions.reason: The question asks for the meaning. The verb form is the one used for a question reported indirectly.

decisions.choice: his disciples asked him: those who ask are given the meaning
decisions.reason: Jesus answers the disciples' question (8:10-15). The difference between those who ask and those who only listen is part of his answer.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Ὑμῖν δέδοται γνῶναι τὰ μυστήρια τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς, ἵνα βλέποντες μὴ βλέπωσιν καὶ ἀκούοντες μὴ συνιῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: And he said: To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest in parables, so that seeing not they may see and hearing not they may understand.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest [they are] in parables, so that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
en.B: He said, "You have been allowed to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but the others receive them in parables, so that they look but do not see, and listen but do not understand.
en.R: He said, "God has given you the gift of knowing the mysteries of the kingdom of God. A mystery is something God kept hidden but now makes known. To others, these things come in parables. So they look but do not see, and they listen but do not understand.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «A {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se {{plural_you:les|os}} ha concedido conocer los misterios del reino de Dios, pero a los demás [se les da] en parábolas, para que viendo no vean, y oyendo no entiendan.
es.B: Él les dijo: «A {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se {{plural_you:les|os}} ha concedido conocer los misterios del reino de Dios; pero los demás los reciben en parábolas, para que miren, pero no vean, y escuchen, pero no entiendan.
es.R: Él les dijo: «Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el regalo de conocer los misterios del reino de Dios. Un misterio es algo que Dios tenía escondido, pero que ahora da a conocer. A los demás, estas cosas les llegan en parábolas. Por eso miran, pero no ven; escuchan, pero no entienden.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « À vous il a été donné de connaître les mystères du royaume de Dieu, mais aux autres [ils sont donnés] en paraboles, afin que, voyant, ils ne voient pas, et qu’entendant, ils ne comprennent pas.
fr.B: Il répondit : « À vous, il a été accordé de connaître les mystères du royaume de Dieu ; mais les autres les reçoivent en paraboles, pour qu’ils regardent sans voir et qu’ils écoutent sans comprendre.
fr.R: Il a dit : « Dieu vous a fait le cadeau de connaître les mystères du royaume de Dieu. Un mystère, c’est quelque chose que Dieu avait gardé caché et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait connaître maintenant. Aux autres, ces choses arrivent en paraboles. Alors ils regardent, mais ils ne voient pas. Ils écoutent, mais ils ne comprennent pas.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Ninyi mmepewa kuzijua siri za ufalme wa Mungu, lakini kwa wale wengine [zinakuja] kwa mifano, ili wakiona wasione, na wakisikia wasielewe.
sw.B: Akasema, "Ninyi mmejaliwa kuzijua siri za ufalme wa Mungu, lakini wengine wanazipokea kwa mifano, ili watazame lakini wasione, wasikilize lakini wasielewe.
sw.R: Aliwaambia, "Mungu amewapa ninyi zawadi ya kuzijua siri za ufalme wa Mungu. Siri ni jambo ambalo Mungu alikuwa amelificha, lakini sasa analifunua. Kwa watu wengine, mambo haya yanakuja kwa mifano. Kwa hiyo wanatazama lakini hawaoni, wanasikiliza lakini hawaelewi.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 말씀하셨다. "너희에게는 하나님의 나라의 비밀들을 아는 것이 주어졌다. 그러나 나머지 사람들에게는 비유로 [주어진다]. 그것은 그들이 보면서도 보지 못하고, 들으면서도 깨닫지 못하게 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "너희에게는 하나님의 나라의 비밀을 아는 것이 허락되었다. 그러나 다른 사람들에게는 비유로 주어진다. 그래서 그들은 보아도 보지 못하고, 들어도 깨닫지 못한다.
ko.R: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "하나님께서 너희에게는 하나님의 나라의 비밀을 알게 해 주셨다. 비밀이란 하나님께서 숨겨 두셨다가 이제 알려 주시는 뜻이다. 그러나 다른 사람들은 이것을 비유로만 듣는다. 그래서 그들은 보아도 보지 못하고, 들어도 깨닫지 못한다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Các con đã được ban cho để biết những sự mầu nhiệm của vương quốc Đức Chúa Trời, còn những người khác thì [được nghe] bằng ngụ ngôn, để họ nhìn mà không thấy, và nghe mà không hiểu.
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Các con đã được ban cho sự hiểu biết những sự mầu nhiệm của vương quốc Đức Chúa Trời, còn những người khác thì nhận được qua ngụ ngôn, để họ nhìn mà không thấy, nghe mà không hiểu.
vi.R: Ngài nói: "Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho các con được biết những sự mầu nhiệm của vương quốc Đức Chúa Trời. Sự mầu nhiệm là điều Đức Chúa Trời đã giấu kín, nhưng nay bày tỏ ra. Còn những người khác thì chỉ nghe những điều ấy qua các câu chuyện. Như vậy, họ nhìn mà không thấy, họ nghe mà không hiểu.

decisions.choice: mysteries: parts of God's plan that were hidden and that God now makes known
decisions.reason: In Scripture a mystery is something people cannot find out by themselves, which God reveals (Daniel 2:28; Ephesians 3:3-5; Colossians 1:26). Here the mysteries are the truths about God's rule that come with Jesus.

decisions.choice: it has been given: given by God
decisions.reason: The passive leaves God as the giver. Knowing the mysteries is a gift, not an achievement.

decisions.choice: seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand: Isaiah 6:9
alternatives: a saying of Jesus with no source in Scripture
decisions.reason: When the LORD sent Isaiah, he told him that the people would hear and not understand, see and not perceive (Isaiah 6:9-10). Jesus applies these words to those who hear only the parables. Luke gives the full passage at Acts 28:26-27.

decisions.choice: so that: purpose
decisions.reason: The word normally states purpose, as in Isaiah, where hearing without understanding is a judgment on a people who refuse to listen. The parables reveal to those who ask (8:9) and hide from those who will not.

decisions.choice: mysteries: the plural of the key term "mystery"
decisions.reason: The Greek word is plural. "Mystery" is a key term and stays at every level; Readable explains it instead of replacing it with "secret".

decisions.choice: God has given you the gift
alternatives: it has been given to you
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the giver, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: los misterios (every level)
decisions.reason: "Misterio" names a part of God's plan, hidden until he makes it known (meaning decision m1), not a puzzle; Readable adds what a mystery is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}}
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to his disciples, so "you" is plural and takes the ustedes / vosotros setting, which has no English counterpart. The same for every plural "you" in this chapter (verses 18, 25 and 52).

decisions.choice: siri (every level)
decisions.reason: A part of God's plan, hidden until he makes it known (meaning decision m1). "Siri" says that; "mafumbo" would be riddles. Readable adds what such a secret is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "비밀들" (L); "비밀" (B, R), as in Mark 4:11
decisions.reason: "비밀" is a secret that is now told, the sense of the meaning decision, and is the word of the Korean Mark; Literal keeps Luke's plural.

decisions.choice: "그래서" (B, R) for hina
alternatives: "그것은 ... 하려는 것이다" (B, R), as at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the purpose clause; Balanced and Readable follow the English and the footnoted meaning decision, which leaves room for purpose or result, with a plain connective rather than spelling out God's purpose.

decisions.choice: "sự mầu nhiệm"; Readable explains it
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:11: "sự mầu nhiệm" is the established word for God's plan once hidden and now made known; "huyền bí" suggests the occult.

source.text: Ἔστιν δὲ αὕτη ἡ παραβολή· Ὁ σπόρος ἐστὶν ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Is now this the parable: The seed is the word of God.

en.L: Now this is the parable: the seed is the word of God.
en.B: This is what the parable means: the seed is the word of God.
en.R: This is what the story means. The seed is the word of God, the message God speaks.

es.L: Y esta es la parábola: la semilla es la palabra de Dios.
es.B: Esto es lo que significa la parábola: la semilla es la palabra de Dios.
es.R: Esto es lo que quiere decir la historia. La semilla es la palabra de Dios, el mensaje que Dios comunica.

fr.L: Or voici la parabole : la semence est la parole de Dieu.
fr.B: Voici ce que signifie la parabole : la semence, c’est la parole de Dieu.
fr.R: Voici ce que veut dire l’histoire. Les graines, c’est la parole de Dieu, le message que Dieu fait entendre.

sw.L: Na mfano ni huu: mbegu ni neno la Mungu.
sw.B: Maana ya mfano huo ni hii: mbegu ni neno la Mungu.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo maana ya mfano huo. Mbegu ni neno la Mungu, yaani ujumbe ambao Mungu anasema.

ko.L: 그런데 그 비유는 이것이다. 씨는 하나님의 말씀이다.
ko.B: 이 비유의 뜻은 이렇다. 씨는 하나님의 말씀이다.
ko.R: 이 이야기의 뜻은 이렇다. 씨는 하나님의 말씀, 곧 하나님께서 하시는 말이다.

vi.L: Vậy ngụ ngôn là thế này: Hạt giống là lời của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Ý nghĩa của ngụ ngôn ấy như sau: hạt giống là lời của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Câu chuyện ấy có nghĩa như thế này. Hạt giống là lời của Đức Chúa Trời, tức là sứ điệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán truyền.

decisions.choice: this is the parable: this is its meaning
alternatives: this is how the story goes
decisions.reason: Jesus now explains the story he has told.

decisions.choice: the word of God: God's message, spoken by Jesus
decisions.reason: The crowds came to hear the word of God from Jesus (5:1). The same phrase returns in 8:21 and 11:28.

decisions.choice: the message God speaks
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase.

decisions.choice: la parole de Dieu, lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: "La parole" here is the message Jesus preaches (m2), not a title, so it is lowercase, as in Mark 4:14. Readable keeps the phrase, which recurs in 8:21, and explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "말씀" for logos through 8:11-15 and 8:21; "하나님께서 하시는 말" added once (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean John and Mark, "말씀" is kept for God's word; Readable explains it once, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "lời của Đức Chúa Trời" (L, B); Readable adds "sứ điệp" and says "sứ điệp ấy" in 8:12-15
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:14: the word is the message Jesus preaches, lowercase "lời", not John's title "Ngôi Lời"; Readable names it a message, as the English Readable does.

source.text: οἱ δὲ παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες, εἶτα ἔρχεται ὁ διάβολος καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον ἀπὸ τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν, ἵνα μὴ πιστεύσαντες σωθῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Those now beside the road are those having heard, then comes the devil and takes away the word from the heart of them, so that not having believed they may be saved.

en.L: And those along the road are the ones who have heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, so that they may not believe and be saved.
en.B: Those beside the road are people who have heard, but then the devil comes and snatches the word out of their hearts, to keep them from believing and being saved.
en.R: The seed on the path is like people who hear the word. But then the devil comes and takes it away from their hearts. He does not want them to believe and be saved.

es.L: Y los de junto al camino son los que oyeron; luego viene el diablo y quita la palabra de su corazón, para que no crean y se salven.
es.B: Los de junto al camino son los que han oído, pero luego viene el diablo y les arrebata la palabra del corazón, para que no crean ni se salven.
es.R: La semilla que cayó en el sendero es como las personas que oyen la palabra. Pero luego viene el diablo y se la quita del corazón. No quiere que crean y se salven.

fr.L: Et ceux qui sont le long du chemin sont ceux qui ont entendu ; ensuite vient le diable, et il enlève la parole de leur cœur, afin qu’ils ne croient pas et ne soient pas sauvés.
fr.B: Ceux qui sont au bord du chemin, ce sont les gens qui ont entendu ; mais ensuite le diable vient et arrache la parole de leur cœur, pour les empêcher de croire et d’être sauvés.
fr.R: Les graines tombées sur le chemin sont comme les gens qui entendent la parole. Mais ensuite, le diable arrive et il l’enlève de leur cœur. Il ne veut pas qu’ils croient et qu’ils soient sauvés.

sw.L: Na wale wa kando ya njia ni wale waliosikia; kisha Ibilisi anakuja na kuliondoa neno mioyoni mwao, ili wasiamini wakaokolewa.
sw.B: Wale wa kando ya njia ni watu waliosikia, lakini kisha Ibilisi huja na kulinyakua neno kutoka mioyoni mwao, ili wasiamini na kuokolewa.
sw.R: Mbegu zilizoanguka njiani ni kama watu wanaosikia neno. Lakini kisha Ibilisi anakuja na kulichukua kutoka mioyoni mwao. Hataki waamini na kuokolewa.

ko.L: 그리고 길가에 있는 것들은 들은 사람들이다. 그다음에 마귀가 와서 그들의 마음에서 말씀을 가져가 버린다. 그들이 믿어서 구원을 받지 못하게 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: 길가에 떨어진 씨는 말씀을 들은 사람들이다. 그러나 마귀가 와서 그들의 마음에서 말씀을 빼앗아 간다. 그들이 믿고 구원을 받지 못하게 하려는 것이다.
ko.R: 길 위에 떨어진 씨는 하나님의 말씀을 듣는 사람들과 같다. 그런데 마귀가 와서 그들의 마음에서 말씀을 빼앗아 간다. 마귀는 그들이 믿고 구원받는 것을 원하지 않는다.

vi.L: Những [hạt] dọc theo lối đi là những người đã nghe, rồi ma quỷ đến và cất lời khỏi lòng họ, kẻo họ tin mà được cứu.
vi.B: Những hạt rơi bên lối đi là những người đã nghe, nhưng rồi ma quỷ đến cướp lời ấy khỏi lòng họ, để họ không thể tin và được cứu.
vi.R: Hạt rơi trên lối đi giống như những người nghe sứ điệp ấy. Nhưng rồi ma quỷ đến và lấy sứ điệp ra khỏi lòng họ. Hắn không muốn họ tin và được cứu.

decisions.choice: those along the road: the people pictured by the seed that fell there
decisions.reason: In the explanation the seed is the word (8:11), but each kind of ground is spoken of as the people who hear. The picture shifts easily between seed and hearers.

decisions.choice: so that they may not believe: the devil's purpose
alternatives: the result of their own lack of interest
decisions.reason: The clause tells why the devil takes the word away. He is the enemy of the word, as the birds are the enemy of the seed.

decisions.choice: believe and be saved: trusting God's word leads to being rescued by God
alternatives: two separate events with no link
decisions.reason: Luke often joins faith and being saved (7:50; 8:48, 50; Acts 16:31). The verb "save" means to rescue, and here it means rescue from sin and its judgment.

decisions.choice: heart: the inner person, where people think, choose and trust
decisions.reason: In Scripture the heart is the center of a person's thinking and will (2:19, 51).

decisions.choice: snatches (B); takes it away (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "snatches" to keep the picture of the birds swooping on the seed.

decisions.choice: He does not want them to believe and be saved.
alternatives: so that they may not believe and be saved
decisions.reason: Readable states the devil's purpose as a short sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: Ibilisi (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet word for "the devil"; "Shetani" is kept for the name Satan, so the two Greek words stay distinct.

decisions.choice: "마귀" for diabolos; "구원을 받다" at every level
alternatives: "사탄", as in Mark 4:15, where the Greek has satanas
decisions.reason: Luke has diabolos here, so Korean says "마귀" (settled for Luke and Matthew). Here being saved is the whole rescue that faith brings (meaning decision), so every level says "구원".

decisions.choice: "ma quỷ"; "hắn" for the devil (R); "kẻo" (L)
decisions.reason: "Ma quỷ" is the settled word for the devil in Luke (4:2), with the narrator's "hắn" for him; "kẻo" (lest) says the devil's purpose, as the meaning decision gives it, in the plain Vietnamese way.

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν μετὰ χαρᾶς δέχονται τὸν λόγον, καὶ οὗτοι ῥίζαν οὐκ ἔχουσιν, οἳ πρὸς καιρὸν πιστεύουσιν καὶ ἐν καιρῷ πειρασμοῦ ἀφίστανται.

records.literal_gloss: Those now upon the rock [are those] who when they hear with joy receive the word, and these a root not have, who for a time believe and in time of testing fall away.

en.L: And those on the rock [are those] who, when they hear, receive the word with joy, and these have no root; they believe for a time, and in a time of testing they fall away.
en.B: Those on the rock are people who welcome the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a season, and when testing comes, they turn away.
en.R: The seed on the rock is like people who hear the word and accept it with joy. But they have no roots. They believe for a little while. Then, when hard times test them, they give up.

es.L: Y los de sobre la roca [son] los que, cuando oyen, reciben la palabra con alegría, y estos no tienen raíz; creen por un tiempo, y en el tiempo de la prueba se apartan.
es.B: Los de sobre la roca son los que reciben la palabra con alegría cuando la oyen, pero no tienen raíz. Creen por algún tiempo, y cuando llega la prueba, se apartan.
es.R: La semilla que cayó sobre la roca es como las personas que oyen la palabra y la aceptan con alegría. Pero no tienen raíces. Creen por un tiempo. Luego, cuando los tiempos difíciles los ponen a prueba, se rinden.

fr.L: Et ceux qui sont sur la roche [sont ceux] qui, lorsqu’ils entendent, reçoivent la parole avec joie ; et ceux-ci n’ont pas de racine : ils croient pour un temps, et au temps de l’épreuve ils se retirent.
fr.B: Ceux qui sont sur la roche, ce sont les gens qui accueillent la parole avec joie quand ils l’entendent, mais ils n’ont pas de racine. Ils croient pour un temps, et quand vient l’épreuve, ils se détournent.
fr.R: Les graines tombées sur la roche sont comme les gens qui entendent la parole et qui l’acceptent avec joie. Mais ils n’ont pas de racines. Ils croient pendant un petit moment. Puis, quand des moments difficiles les mettent à l’épreuve, ils abandonnent.

sw.L: Na wale walio juu ya mwamba [ni wale] ambao wanaposikia hulipokea neno kwa furaha, nao hawa hawana mizizi; huamini kwa muda, na wakati wa kujaribiwa hujitenga.
sw.B: Wale walio juu ya mwamba ni watu ambao wanaposikia neno hulipokea kwa furaha, lakini hawana mizizi. Huamini kwa muda fulani, na wakati wa kujaribiwa unapofika, hurudi nyuma.
sw.R: Mbegu zilizoanguka juu ya mwamba ni kama watu wanaosikia neno na kulipokea kwa furaha. Lakini hawana mizizi. Wanaamini kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha nyakati ngumu zinapowajaribu, wanakata tamaa.

ko.L: 그리고 바위 위에 있는 것들은, 들을 때에 기쁨으로 말씀을 받아들이는 사람들이다. 그러나 이들은 뿌리가 없어서, 한동안 믿다가 시험의 때에 떨어져 나간다.
ko.B: 바위 위에 떨어진 씨는 말씀을 들을 때에 기쁨으로 받아들이는 사람들이다. 그러나 그들은 뿌리가 없어서 잠시 동안 믿다가, 시험이 닥치면 떨어져 나간다.
ko.R: 바위 위에 떨어진 씨는 말씀을 듣고 기쁨으로 받아들이는 사람들과 같다. 그러나 그들에게는 뿌리가 없다. 그들은 잠깐 동안만 믿는다. 그러다가 어려운 일이 닥쳐 그들을 시험하면, 믿음을 버리고 만다.

vi.L: Những [hạt] trên đá là những người khi nghe thì vui mừng tiếp nhận lời, nhưng những người này không có rễ; họ tin trong một thời gian, và trong lúc thử thách thì lìa bỏ.
vi.B: Những hạt rơi trên đất đá là những người khi nghe thì vui mừng đón nhận lời, nhưng họ không có rễ. Họ tin được một thời gian, rồi khi gặp thử thách thì lìa bỏ.
vi.R: Hạt rơi trên đá giống như những người nghe sứ điệp ấy và vui mừng tiếp nhận. Nhưng họ không có rễ. Họ chỉ tin được ít lâu. Rồi khi gặp khó khăn thử thách, họ từ bỏ niềm tin.

decisions.choice: have no root: their trust has no depth
alternatives: they have no family or home
decisions.reason: The picture goes back to the seed on rock (8:6): it sprouts, but has no roots to keep it alive.

decisions.choice: testing: a trial that shows whether someone will stay faithful
decisions.reason: The word can mean temptation or trial. Here it is a time of hardship or pressure, like the trouble or persecution of Mark 4:17, that tests their faith.

decisions.choice: fall away: withdraw, turn away from what they believed
decisions.reason: The verb means to stand off or depart. They abandon the word they welcomed.

decisions.choice: when hard times test them, they give up
alternatives: in a time of testing they fall away
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the testing is and what falling away means.

decisions.choice: "기쁨" at every level; "시험" for peirasmos; "떨어져 나가다" (L, B), "믿음을 버리다" (R) for aphistamai
decisions.reason: Joy is a key term. Luke's verb is "withdraw", not Mark's "stumble", so Korean uses a different verb from Mark 4:17; Readable says what they withdraw from (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "lìa bỏ" (L, B); "từ bỏ niềm tin" (R) for falling away
decisions.reason: Luke's verb means to withdraw or turn away (meaning decision), not Mark's word for stumbling ("vấp ngã", Mark 4:17); "lìa bỏ" says that. Readable uses Mark's Readable wording, which says the same thing plainly.

source.text: τὸ δὲ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας πεσόν, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες, καὶ ὑπὸ μεριμνῶν καὶ πλούτου καὶ ἡδονῶν τοῦ βίου πορευόμενοι συμπνίγονται καὶ οὐ τελεσφοροῦσιν.

records.literal_gloss: That now into the thorns having fallen, these are those having heard, and by cares and riches and pleasures of the life going along are choked and do not bring to maturity.

en.L: And that which fell into the thorns, these are the ones who have heard, and going along, they are choked by worries and riches and pleasures of life, and they do not bring [fruit] to maturity.
en.B: As for the seed that fell among thorns, these are people who hear, but as they go through life, the worries, wealth and pleasures of living choke them, so that their fruit never ripens.
en.R: The seed that fell among the thorny weeds is like people who hear the word. But as they go on living, worries, money and the pleasures of life choke them. They never produce ripe fruit.

es.L: Y lo que cayó entre los espinos, estos son los que oyeron, y, yendo [por la vida], son ahogados por las preocupaciones y las riquezas y los placeres de la vida, y no llevan [fruto] a la madurez.
es.B: En cuanto a la semilla que cayó entre espinos, son los que oyen, pero a medida que avanzan por la vida, las preocupaciones, las riquezas y los placeres de esta vida los ahogan, y su fruto nunca madura.
es.R: La semilla que cayó entre las hierbas con espinas es como las personas que oyen la palabra. Pero mientras siguen viviendo, las preocupaciones, el dinero y los placeres de la vida las ahogan. Nunca dan fruto maduro.

fr.L: Et ce qui est tombé dans les épines, ce sont ceux qui ont entendu, et, chemin faisant, ils sont étouffés par les soucis et la richesse et les plaisirs de la vie, et ils ne mènent pas [de fruit] à maturité.
fr.B: Quant à la semence tombée parmi les ronces, ce sont les gens qui entendent, mais, au fil de la vie, les soucis, la richesse et les plaisirs de l’existence les étouffent, et leur fruit n’arrive jamais à maturité.
fr.R: Les graines tombées au milieu des mauvaises herbes sont comme les gens qui entendent la parole. Mais pendant qu’ils continuent à vivre, les soucis, l’argent et les plaisirs de la vie les étouffent. Ils ne donnent jamais de fruit mûr.

sw.L: Na zile zilizoanguka katika miiba, hao ndio wale waliosikia, na katika kwenda kwao, wanasongwa na masumbufu na mali na anasa za maisha, wala hawafikishi [matunda] kukomaa.
sw.B: Zile zilizoanguka kati ya miiba ni watu wanaosikia, lakini wanapoendelea na maisha, masumbufu, mali na anasa za maisha huwasonga, hata matunda yao hayakomai kamwe.
sw.R: Mbegu zilizoanguka kati ya magugu yenye miiba ni kama watu wanaosikia neno. Lakini wanapoendelea kuishi, wasiwasi, fedha na anasa za maisha huwasonga. Hawazai kamwe matunda yaliyokomaa.

ko.L: 그리고 가시덤불 속에 떨어진 것, 이들은 들은 사람들인데, 살아가면서 삶의 염려와 재물과 쾌락에 숨이 막혀서 [열매를] 익히지 못한다.
ko.B: 가시덤불 속에 떨어진 씨는 말씀을 들은 사람들이다. 그러나 그들은 살아가는 동안 걱정과 재물과 삶의 즐거움에 짓눌려서, 열매가 익지 못한다.
ko.R: 가시덤불 사이에 떨어진 씨는 하나님의 말씀을 듣는 사람들과 같다. 그러나 그들은 살아가면서 걱정거리와 돈과 세상의 즐거움에 눌려 버린다. 그래서 익은 열매를 맺지 못한다.

vi.L: Còn [hạt] rơi vào bụi gai, đó là những người đã nghe, và khi bước đi [trong đời], họ bị những lo toan, giàu sang và thú vui của đời sống làm nghẹt, và không đem [trái] đến chỗ chín.
vi.B: Hạt rơi vào bụi gai là những người đã nghe, nhưng trong khi sống ở đời, họ bị những lo toan, của cải và thú vui của cuộc sống làm nghẹt, nên trái không bao giờ chín.
vi.R: Hạt rơi giữa đám cỏ gai giống như những người nghe sứ điệp ấy. Nhưng khi họ tiếp tục sống, những lo lắng, tiền bạc và thú vui của đời này chèn ép họ. Họ không bao giờ sinh ra trái chín.

decisions.choice: going along: as their lives go on
alternatives: while they walk away from Jesus
decisions.reason: The participle pictures life as a journey. The choking happens slowly, along the way.

decisions.choice: worries: anxious concern about daily life
decisions.reason: Jesus warns against this kind of worry elsewhere (12:22-26; 21:34).

decisions.choice: do not bring to maturity: their fruit never ripens
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring fruit to full ripeness. The plant grows, but it never yields a harvest.

decisions.choice: hear the word
decisions.reason: Readable says what they hear, from 8:11-12.

decisions.choice: "[열매를] 익히지 못한다" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means to bring fruit to ripeness; Korean needs the object, so Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: "những lo toan" (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:19: "lo toan" is anxious concern about the needs of daily life, the sense of the meaning decision; Readable uses the everyday "lo lắng".

source.text: τὸ δὲ ἐν τῇ καλῇ γῇ, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἵτινες ἐν καρδίᾳ καλῇ καὶ ἀγαθῇ ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον κατέχουσιν καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἐν ὑπομονῇ.

records.literal_gloss: That now in the good soil, these are those who in a heart fine and good having heard the word hold [it] fast and bear fruit in endurance.

en.L: And that in the good soil, these are the ones who, having heard the word with a fine and good heart, hold it fast and bear fruit with endurance.
en.B: As for the seed in the good soil, these are people with a good and upright heart. They hear the word, hold on to it, and through endurance bear fruit.
en.R: The seed on good soil is like people who hear the word with a good and honest heart. They hold on to it. They keep going, even when it is hard, and they produce a good crop.

es.L: Y lo [que cayó] en la buena tierra, estos son los que, habiendo oído la palabra con un corazón noble y bueno, la retienen y dan fruto con perseverancia.
es.B: Y la semilla en la buena tierra son los que tienen un corazón noble y bueno. Oyen la palabra, la retienen y, con perseverancia, dan fruto.
es.R: La semilla que cayó en tierra buena es como las personas que oyen la palabra con un corazón bueno y sincero. La guardan. Siguen adelante aunque sea difícil, y dan una buena cosecha.

fr.L: Et ce qui est dans la bonne terre, ce sont ceux qui, ayant entendu la parole avec un cœur noble et bon, la retiennent et portent du fruit avec persévérance.
fr.B: Quant à la semence tombée dans la bonne terre, ce sont les gens au cœur bon et droit. Ils entendent la parole, ils la gardent, et ils portent du fruit par leur persévérance.
fr.R: Les graines tombées dans la bonne terre sont comme les gens qui entendent la parole avec un cœur bon et honnête. Ils la gardent. Ils continuent, même quand c’est difficile, et ils produisent une belle récolte.

sw.L: Na zile zilizo katika udongo mzuri, hao ndio wale ambao, wakiisha kulisikia neno kwa moyo mwema na mzuri, hulishika na kuzaa matunda kwa saburi.
sw.B: Zile zilizo katika udongo mzuri ni watu wenye moyo mwema na mnyoofu. Wanalisikia neno, wanalishika, na kwa saburi wanazaa matunda.
sw.R: Mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri ni kama watu wanaosikia neno kwa moyo mwema na wa kweli. Wanalishika. Wanaendelea mbele hata wakati mambo ni magumu, nao wanatoa mavuno mazuri.

ko.L: 그리고 좋은 땅에 있는 것, 이들은 훌륭하고 선한 마음으로 말씀을 듣고 굳게 지켜서 인내로 열매를 맺는 사람들이다.
ko.B: 좋은 땅에 떨어진 씨는 바르고 선한 마음으로 말씀을 듣는 사람들이다. 그들은 말씀을 굳게 지키고, 끝까지 참고 견디며 열매를 맺는다.
ko.R: 좋은 땅에 떨어진 씨는 착하고 정직한 마음으로 하나님의 말씀을 듣는 사람들과 같다. 그들은 그 말씀을 꼭 붙든다. 힘든 일이 있어도 포기하지 않는다. 그래서 좋은 열매를 많이 맺는다.

vi.L: Còn [hạt] trong đất tốt, đó là những người đã nghe lời với tấm lòng tốt đẹp và lương thiện, giữ chặt [lời ấy], và kết quả trong sự kiên trì.
vi.B: Còn hạt rơi vào đất tốt là những người có tấm lòng tốt đẹp và ngay thẳng. Họ nghe lời, giữ chặt lời ấy, và nhờ kiên trì mà sinh hoa kết quả.
vi.R: Hạt rơi vào đất tốt giống như những người nghe sứ điệp ấy với tấm lòng tốt và thật thà. Họ giữ chặt sứ điệp ấy. Họ cứ bền lòng, dù gặp khó khăn, và sinh ra một vụ mùa tốt.

decisions.choice: a fine and good heart: an upright character, ready to receive and obey
alternatives: a heart that is already perfect
decisions.reason: "Fine and good" was a common Greek way to describe a person of noble character. Here it describes hearers who take the word in and keep it.

decisions.choice: hold it fast: keep it and not let it go
decisions.reason: The word is not snatched away (8:12) or abandoned (8:13). It stays and does its work.

decisions.choice: endurance: steady perseverance through difficulty
decisions.reason: This is the opposite of falling away in a time of testing (8:13). Fruit comes over time, through faithful endurance (21:19).

decisions.choice: They keep going, even when it is hard
decisions.reason: Readable explains endurance in plain words.

decisions.choice: "인내" (L); "끝까지 참고 견디며" (B); "힘든 일이 있어도 포기하지 않는다" (R) for hypomonē
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun; Balanced and Readable say what endurance is (meaning decision), the Readable sentence matching the English Readable's expansion.

decisions.choice: "sự kiên trì" (L); "kiên trì" (B) for endurance
decisions.reason: The word used for endurance in the Vietnamese Romans (5:3); it means holding on through difficulty, the sense of the meaning decision. Readable says it plainly.

source.text: Οὐδεὶς δὲ λύχνον ἅψας καλύπτει αὐτὸν σκεύει ἢ ὑποκάτω κλίνης τίθησιν, ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ λυχνίας τίθησιν, ἵνα οἱ εἰσπορευόμενοι βλέπωσιν τὸ φῶς.

records.literal_gloss: No one now a lamp having lit covers it with a vessel or under a bed puts [it], but on a lampstand puts [it], so that those entering may see the light.

en.L: Now no one, after lighting a lamp, covers it with a vessel or puts [it] underneath a bed, but puts [it] on a lampstand, so that those who come in may see the light.
en.B: Nobody who has lit a lamp then covers it with a bowl or tucks it under a bed. A lamp goes on a lampstand, where those who enter can see its light.
en.R: People do not light a lamp and then cover it with a bowl or put it under a bed. They set the lamp up high on a stand. Then everyone who comes into the house can see the light.

es.L: Y nadie, después de encender una lámpara, la cubre con una vasija o [la] pone debajo de una cama, sino que [la] pone sobre un candelero, para que los que entran vean la luz.
es.B: Nadie enciende una lámpara para luego taparla con una vasija o meterla debajo de una cama. La lámpara se pone en un candelero, para que los que entran vean su luz.
es.R: Nadie enciende una lámpara y luego la tapa con un cuenco o la pone debajo de una cama. Se pone en alto, sobre un soporte. Así todos los que entran en la casa pueden ver la luz.

fr.L: Or personne, après avoir allumé une lampe, ne la couvre d’un vase ou ne [la] met sous un lit ; mais [on la] met sur un porte-lampe, afin que ceux qui entrent voient la lumière.
fr.B: Personne n’allume une lampe pour la couvrir ensuite d’un récipient ou la glisser sous un lit. On pose la lampe sur un support, pour que ceux qui entrent en voient la lumière.
fr.R: On n’allume pas une lampe pour la cacher ensuite sous un bol ou sous un lit. On la pose en hauteur, sur un support. Alors tous ceux qui entrent dans la maison peuvent voir la lumière.

sw.L: Na hakuna mtu ambaye, akiisha kuwasha taa, huifunika kwa chombo au huiweka chini ya kitanda, bali huiweka juu ya kinara, ili wale wanaoingia wauone mwanga.
sw.B: Hakuna mtu anayewasha taa kisha akaifunika kwa bakuli au kuiweka chini ya kitanda. Taa huwekwa juu ya kinara, ili wanaoingia wauone mwanga wake.
sw.R: Watu hawawashi taa kisha kuifunika kwa bakuli au kuiweka chini ya kitanda. Wanaiweka juu, kwenye kinara. Hivyo kila anayeingia ndani ya nyumba anaweza kuuona mwanga.

ko.L: 아무도 등불을 켜서 그릇으로 덮거나 침상 아래에 두지 않는다. 오히려 등잔대 위에 두어서, 들어오는 사람들이 빛을 보게 한다.
ko.B: 등불을 켜서 그릇으로 덮어 두거나 침상 밑에 두는 사람은 없다. 등불은 등잔대 위에 두어서, 들어오는 사람들이 그 빛을 볼 수 있게 한다.
ko.R: 등불을 켜 놓고 그릇으로 덮거나 침대 밑에 두는 사람은 없다. 등불은 높은 받침대 위에 놓는다. 그래야 집에 들어오는 사람들이 모두 그 빛을 볼 수 있다.

vi.L: Không ai thắp đèn rồi lấy đồ đựng úp nó lại, hoặc đặt [nó] dưới gầm giường, nhưng đặt [nó] trên chân đèn, để những người đi vào thấy ánh sáng.
vi.B: Không ai thắp đèn rồi lấy cái chậu úp lại, hay để dưới gầm giường. Người ta đặt đèn trên chân đèn, để ai bước vào cũng thấy ánh sáng.
vi.R: Người ta không thắp đèn rồi lấy cái chậu úp lại, hay để đèn dưới gầm giường. Họ đặt đèn lên cao trên chân đèn. Như vậy, ai vào nhà cũng thấy ánh sáng.

decisions.choice: lamp, lampstand: a small clay lamp that burned olive oil, set on a stand to light the room
decisions.reason: A household lamp gave little light. Set up on a stand, it lit the whole room.

decisions.choice: vessel: any container, such as a jar or bowl
decisions.reason: The word is general. Turned over a lamp, a vessel would hide its light.

decisions.choice: the lamp is set up to be seen: what Jesus has made known is meant to shine out
alternatives: a rule about household lamps only
decisions.reason: The saying follows the explanation of the parable. The mysteries now given to the disciples (8:10) are not meant to stay hidden (8:17).

decisions.choice: up high; into the house
decisions.reason: Readable explains why a lamp stands on a stand, and where people come in.

decisions.choice: "그릇"; "침상" (L, B), "침대" (R); "등잔대" (L, B), "받침대" (R), as in Mark 4:21
decisions.reason: The synoptic parallel keeps the Korean Mark's words; "등경" is the older word of familiar versions.

decisions.choice: "đồ đựng" (L); "cái chậu" (B, R) for the vessel
decisions.reason: Luke's word is any container (meaning decision), not Mark's grain measure ("cái thúng"); Literal keeps the general word, and Balanced and Readable name a bowl that could cover a lamp.

source.text: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ φανερὸν γενήσεται, οὐδὲ ἀπόκρυφον ὃ οὐ μὴ γνωσθῇ καὶ εἰς φανερὸν ἔλθῃ.

records.literal_gloss: Not for is hidden which not visible will become, nor secret which not not shall be known and into visible come.

en.L: For there is nothing hidden that will not become visible, nor [anything] secret that will not be known and come into the open.
en.B: Whatever is hidden will be shown plainly, and whatever is kept secret will surely be known and brought to light.
en.R: Everything that is hidden will be shown. Every secret will become known and will come out into the open.

es.L: Porque no hay [nada] oculto que no llegue a ser manifiesto, ni [nada] secreto que no llegue a conocerse y a salir a la luz.
es.B: Todo lo que está escondido será mostrado claramente, y todo lo que se mantiene en secreto llegará sin falta a conocerse y saldrá a la luz.
es.R: Todo lo que está escondido se va a mostrar. Todo secreto se va a conocer y va a salir a la vista de todos.

fr.L: Car il n’y a rien de caché qui ne doive devenir visible, ni rien de secret qui ne doive être connu et venir au grand jour.
fr.B: Tout ce qui est caché sera mis en pleine lumière, et tout ce qui est tenu secret sera connu et paraîtra au grand jour.
fr.R: Tout ce qui est caché sera montré. Tous les secrets seront connus et sortiront au grand jour.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakuna [kitu] kilichofichwa ambacho hakitakuwa dhahiri, wala [kitu] cha siri ambacho hakitajulikana na kuja mahali pa wazi.
sw.B: Kila kilichofichwa kitaonyeshwa waziwazi, na kila kilichowekwa siri hakika kitajulikana na kuletwa nuruni.
sw.R: Kila kitu kilichofichwa kitaonyeshwa. Kila siri itajulikana na kuwekwa wazi.

ko.L: 드러나지 않을 숨겨진 것이 없고, 알려져서 드러나지 않을 감추어진 것도 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 숨겨진 것은 모두 드러나고, 감추어진 것은 반드시 알려져서 밝히 나타날 것이다.
ko.R: 숨겨진 것은 모두 드러나게 된다. 비밀은 모두 알려지게 되고, 모든 사람 앞에 환히 드러날 것이다.

vi.L: Vì chẳng có gì kín giấu mà sẽ không trở nên rõ ràng, cũng chẳng có gì bí mật mà sẽ không được biết đến và không ra chỗ công khai.
vi.B: Mọi điều bị giấu kín sẽ được tỏ ra, và mọi điều bí mật chắc chắn sẽ được biết đến và đưa ra ánh sáng.
vi.R: Mọi điều bị giấu kín sẽ được bày tỏ. Mọi điều bí mật sẽ được mọi người biết và được đưa ra công khai.

decisions.choice: will surely be known: a strong denial that it could stay unknown
decisions.reason: The double negative is the strongest form of denial. It is certain that the secret will come out.

decisions.choice: what is hidden will be revealed: here, the truth about God's kingdom, now hidden from many, will be made plain
alternatives: only that people's sins will be exposed
decisions.reason: In this setting the saying follows the mysteries given to the disciples (8:10) and the lamp (8:16). At 12:2 a similar saying warns that hidden hypocrisy will be exposed.

decisions.choice: positive statements: whatever is hidden will be shown
alternatives: there is nothing hidden that will not be shown
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the double negatives into plain statements with the same meaning.

source.text: βλέπετε οὖν πῶς ἀκούετε· ὃς ἂν γὰρ ἔχῃ, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ, καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ ἔχῃ, καὶ ὃ δοκεῖ ἔχειν ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: See therefore how you hear; whoever for may have, it will be given to him, and whoever not may have, even what he seems to have will be taken away from him.

en.L: So watch how you hear; for whoever has, [more] will be given to {{gender:them|him}}, and whoever does not have, even what {{gender:they seem|he seems}} to have will be taken away from {{gender:them|him}}."
en.B: So pay attention to how you listen. Those who have will receive more. Those who do not have will lose even what they seem to have."
en.R: So be careful how you listen! People who have something will be given more. But people who have nothing will lose even what they think they have."

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, pues, cómo {{plural_you:oyen|oís}}; porque al que tenga, se le dará [más], y al que no tenga, aun lo que le parece tener se le quitará».
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} atención a cómo {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}. A los que tienen se les dará más; a los que no tienen se les quitará incluso lo que parecen tener».
es.R: Por eso, ¡{{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado de cómo {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}! A las personas que tienen algo se les dará más. Pero a las que no tienen nada se les quitará incluso lo que creen tener».

fr.L: Prenez donc garde à la manière dont vous entendez ; car celui qui a, il lui sera donné [davantage], et celui qui n’a pas, même ce qu’il semble avoir lui sera enlevé. »
fr.B: Faites donc attention à la manière dont vous écoutez. Ceux qui ont recevront davantage ; ceux qui n’ont pas perdront même ce qu’ils semblent avoir. »
fr.R: Faites donc bien attention à votre façon d’écouter ! Les gens qui ont quelque chose recevront encore plus. Mais les gens qui n’ont rien perdront même ce qu’ils pensent avoir. »

sw.L: Basi angalieni jinsi mnavyosikia; kwa maana yeyote aliye na [kitu], atapewa [zaidi], na yeyote asiye na [kitu], hata kile anachodhani kuwa nacho kitachukuliwa kutoka kwake."
sw.B: Basi zingatieni jinsi mnavyosikiliza. Walio na kitu watapewa zaidi, na wasio na kitu watanyang'anywa hata kile wanachoonekana kuwa nacho."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo jihadharini jinsi mnavyosikiliza! Watu walio na kitu watapewa zaidi. Lakini watu wasio na kitu watapoteza hata kile wanachodhani wanacho."

ko.L: 그러므로 너희가 어떻게 듣는지 잘 살펴라. 누구든지 가진 사람은 [더] 받을 것이고, 가지지 못한 사람은 가졌다고 생각하는 것마저 빼앗길 것이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러므로 너희가 어떻게 듣는지 주의하여라. 가진 사람은 더 받을 것이고, 가지지 못한 사람은 가진 줄로 여기는 것마저 빼앗길 것이다."
ko.R: 그러니 말씀을 어떻게 듣는지 조심해라! 무엇이든 가진 사람은 더 받게 된다. 그러나 아무것도 갖지 못한 사람은 가졌다고 생각하는 것마저 빼앗기게 된다."
