sw.L: Na wale waliokuwa wakiwachunga walipoona kilichotokea, walikimbia, wakatangaza [habari] mjini na mashambani.
sw.B: Wachungaji wa nguruwe walipoona yaliyotokea, walikimbia, wakaeneza habari mjini na mashambani.
sw.R: Wale waliokuwa wakichunga nguruwe waliona yaliyotokea. Walikimbia, wakawaeleza watu wa mjini na wa vijijini.

ko.L: 그런데 돼지를 치던 사람들이 일어난 일을 보고 달아나서 고을과 농촌에 [그 일을] 알렸다.
ko.B: 돼지를 치던 사람들이 이 일을 보고 달아나서, 읍내와 근처 농가들에 소식을 퍼뜨렸다.
ko.R: 돼지를 돌보던 사람들이 이 일을 보았다. 그들은 도망쳐서 마을과 농촌에 사는 사람들에게 이 일을 알렸다.

vi.L: Khi những người chăn [heo] thấy việc đã xảy ra, họ bỏ chạy và báo tin trong thành và ở các vùng quê.
vi.B: Thấy việc đã xảy ra, những người chăn heo bỏ chạy và loan tin trong thị trấn và khắp các làng quê.
vi.R: Những người chăn heo thấy việc đã xảy ra. Họ bỏ chạy và kể cho mọi người trong thị trấn và ở vùng quê chung quanh.

decisions.choice: those feeding them: the herders
decisions.reason: The participle is the same verb used of the pigs "feeding" in 8:32, here in the sense of tending a herd.

decisions.choice: the fields: the farms and villages around the town
decisions.reason: The news spread both in the town and through the surrounding countryside.

decisions.choice: told people
decisions.reason: Readable supplies whom they told.

source.text: ἐξῆλθον δὲ ἰδεῖν τὸ γεγονὸς καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ εὗρον καθήμενον τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἀφ’ οὗ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐξῆλθεν ἱματισμένον καὶ σωφρονοῦντα παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.

records.literal_gloss: They went out then to see the [thing] having happened and came to Jesus, and found sitting the man from whom the demons had gone out, clothed and being of sound mind, at the feet of Jesus; and they were afraid.

en.L: And they went out to see what had happened, and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out sitting, clothed and of sound mind, at the feet of Jesus; and they were afraid.
en.B: People came out to see what had taken place. When they reached Jesus, they found the man whom the demons had left sitting at the feet of Jesus, wearing clothes and thinking clearly. And they were frightened.
en.R: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus. There they saw the man who had had the demons. He was sitting at the feet of Jesus. He had clothes on, and his mind was clear. The people were afraid.

es.L: Y salieron a ver lo que había sucedido, y vinieron a Jesús y encontraron sentado al hombre de quien habían salido los demonios, vestido y en su sano juicio, a los pies de Jesús; y tuvieron miedo.
es.B: La gente salió a ver lo que había pasado. Cuando llegaron adonde estaba Jesús, encontraron sentado a los pies de Jesús al hombre del que habían salido los demonios, vestido y en su sano juicio. Y se asustaron.
es.R: La gente salió a ver lo que había pasado. Llegaron adonde estaba Jesús. Allí vieron al hombre que había tenido los demonios. Estaba sentado a los pies de Jesús. Tenía ropa puesta y su mente estaba clara. La gente tuvo miedo.

fr.L: Et ils sortirent pour voir ce qui était arrivé, et ils vinrent vers Jésus, et ils trouvèrent l’homme dont les démons étaient sortis assis, vêtu et dans son bon sens, aux pieds de Jésus ; et ils eurent peur.
fr.B: Les gens sortirent pour voir ce qui s’était passé. Arrivés près de Jésus, ils trouvèrent l’homme que les démons avaient quitté assis aux pieds de Jésus, habillé et sain d’esprit. Et ils furent saisis de crainte.
fr.R: Les gens sont sortis pour voir ce qui s’était passé. Ils sont arrivés près de Jésus. Là, ils ont vu l’homme qui avait eu les démons. Il était assis aux pieds de Jésus. Il portait des vêtements, et il avait de nouveau l’esprit clair. Les gens ont eu peur.

sw.L: Nao wakatoka kwenda kuona kilichotokea, wakaja kwa Yesu, wakamkuta yule mtu ambaye pepo walikuwa wamemtoka ameketi, amevaa nguo na ana akili timamu, miguuni pa Yesu; nao wakaogopa.
sw.B: Watu walitoka kwenda kuona yaliyotokea. Walipofika kwa Yesu, walimkuta yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo ameketi miguuni pa Yesu, amevaa nguo na akili zake zikiwa timamu. Nao wakaogopa.
sw.R: Watu walitoka kwenda kuona yaliyotokea. Walifika kwa Yesu. Huko walimwona yule mtu aliyekuwa na pepo. Alikuwa ameketi miguuni pa Yesu. Alikuwa amevaa nguo, na akili zake zilikuwa sawa. Watu wakaogopa.

ko.L: 그러자 [사람들이] 일어난 일을 보려고 나와서 예수께 왔다. 그리고 귀신들이 나간 그 사람이 옷을 입고 제정신으로 예수의 발 앞에 앉아 있는 것을 보았다. 그러자 그들은 두려워했다.
ko.B: 사람들이 무슨 일이 일어났는지 보려고 나왔다. 그들은 예수께 와서, 귀신들이 나간 그 사람이 옷을 입고 멀쩡한 정신으로 예수의 발 앞에 앉아 있는 것을 보았다. 그러자 그들은 두려워졌다.
ko.R: 사람들이 무슨 일이 일어났는지 보려고 나왔다. 그들은 예수께 왔다. 거기서 그들은 귀신 들렸던 그 사람을 보았다. 그는 예수의 발 앞에 앉아 있었다. 옷을 입고 있었고, 정신도 맑았다. 사람들은 무서워했다.

vi.L: Và [người ta] đi ra để xem việc đã xảy ra, và đến cùng Đức Giê-xu, và thấy người mà các quỷ đã ra khỏi đang ngồi dưới chân Đức Giê-xu, mặc áo và tỉnh trí; và họ sợ hãi.
vi.B: Người ta kéo ra xem việc đã xảy ra. Khi đến chỗ Đức Giê-xu, họ thấy người mà các quỷ đã rời khỏi đang ngồi dưới chân Đức Giê-xu, mặc quần áo và tỉnh táo. Họ đâm ra sợ hãi.
vi.R: Dân chúng đi ra xem việc đã xảy ra. Họ đến chỗ Đức Giê-xu. Ở đó họ thấy người trước kia bị quỷ ám. Anh ta đang ngồi dưới chân Đức Giê-xu. Anh ta đã mặc quần áo, và đầu óc tỉnh táo. Dân chúng sợ hãi.

decisions.choice: sitting at the feet of Jesus: the place of a learner
alternatives: sitting on the ground to rest
decisions.reason: A disciple sat at a teacher's feet (10:39; Acts 22:3). The man who had lived among the tombs now sits as a disciple.

decisions.choice: of sound mind: thinking clearly, in control of himself
decisions.reason: The verb means to be of sound mind. It is the opposite of the wild life described in 8:27-29.

decisions.choice: they were afraid: they were struck with fear at a power they did not understand
alternatives: they were afraid of the man
decisions.reason: As with the disciples in the boat (8:25), seeing God's power at work brings fear. This fear makes the people ask Jesus to leave (8:37).

decisions.choice: People
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who went out: those who heard the herders' news.

decisions.choice: "[사람들이]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves "they" to the verb; Korean narrative needs a subject here after the herders of 8:34, so Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: "제정신으로" (L); "멀쩡한 정신으로" (B); "정신도 맑았다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 5:15: he was thinking clearly and in control of himself (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "[người ta]" (L)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a subject where the Greek verb carries one; the people of the town are meant (8:34).

source.text: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτοῖς οἱ ἰδόντες πῶς ἐσώθη ὁ δαιμονισθείς.

records.literal_gloss: Reported then to them those having seen how was saved the [one] having been demon-possessed.

en.L: And those who had seen [it] reported to them how the one who had been demon-possessed had been saved.
en.B: Those who had seen it told them how the man who had been under the power of demons had been made well.
en.R: The people who had seen it all told the others how Jesus had made the man well.

es.L: Y los que [lo] habían visto les contaron cómo había sido salvado el que había estado endemoniado.
es.B: Los que lo habían visto les contaron cómo había quedado sano el hombre que había estado dominado por los demonios.
es.R: Los que habían visto todo les contaron a los demás cómo Jesús había sanado al hombre.

fr.L: Et ceux qui [l’]avaient vu leur racontèrent comment le démoniaque avait été sauvé.
fr.B: Ceux qui avaient tout vu leur racontèrent comment l’homme qui avait été sous l’emprise des démons avait été guéri.
fr.R: Ceux qui avaient tout vu ont raconté aux autres comment Jésus avait guéri l’homme.

sw.L: Na wale walioona wakawaeleza jinsi yule aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo alivyookoka.
sw.B: Wale walioyaona waliwaeleza jinsi yule mtu aliyekuwa ametawaliwa na pepo alivyoponywa.
sw.R: Watu walioyaona yote waliwaeleza wengine jinsi Yesu alivyomponya yule mtu.

ko.L: 그러자 본 사람들이 귀신 들렸던 사람이 어떻게 구원을 받았는지 그들에게 알렸다.
ko.B: 그 일을 본 사람들이, 귀신 들렸던 사람이 어떻게 낫게 되었는지 그들에게 이야기해 주었다.
ko.R: 모든 것을 본 사람들이 다른 사람들에게, 예수께서 그 사람을 어떻게 낫게 해 주셨는지 이야기해 주었다.

vi.L: Và những người đã thấy [việc ấy] thuật lại cho họ thể nào người bị quỷ ám đã được cứu.
vi.B: Những người đã chứng kiến kể lại cho họ người bị quỷ ám đã được chữa lành thế nào.
vi.R: Những người đã thấy tận mắt kể cho những người khác nghe Đức Giê-xu đã chữa lành người ấy thế nào.

decisions.choice: had been saved: rescued from the demons and made well
decisions.reason: The verb means to save or rescue. Here it is the man's deliverance from the demons and his return to health and a sound mind. Luke uses the same verb for the healed woman (8:48), for Jairus's daughter (8:50) and for salvation (8:12).

decisions.choice: the one who had been demon-possessed: the man the demons had controlled
alternatives: a man with a mental illness
decisions.reason: The verb means to be under the power of a demon, as in 8:27.

decisions.choice: made well
decisions.reason: "Saved" alone would sound like a statement only about the man's soul. Balanced and Readable say what happened to him; Literal keeps "saved" and its link with 8:12 and 8:48.

decisions.choice: Jesus had made the man well
alternatives: the man had been made well
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus as the one who did it, from 8:35 and 8:39.

decisions.choice: había sido salvado (L); había quedado sano (B); había sanado (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means rescued from the demons and made well (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "salvar", which says more than getting well, as in Mark 5:23; Balanced and Readable say "made well", as the English does. The same in verses 48 and 50.

decisions.choice: alivyookoka (L); alivyoponywa (B); alivyomponya (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means rescued from the demons and made well (meaning decision m1). "Kuokoka" means both to recover and to be saved, so Literal keeps the double sense, as in Mark 5:23; Balanced and Readable say "made well", as the English does. The same in verses 48 and 50.

decisions.choice: "구원을 받다" (L); "낫다" (B, R) for sōzō where it means being made well (8:36, 8:48, 8:50), as in Mark 5
decisions.reason: The verb means both rescue and being made well (meaning decisions); Literal keeps "구원" so the link with salvation shows, while Balanced and Readable say what happened to the man, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "được cứu" (L); "được chữa lành" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "save", here rescue from the demons and healing (meaning decision). Literal keeps "cứu", as in 8:48 and 8:50, so the reader sees one word; Balanced and Readable say what happened, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ἠρώτησεν αὐτὸν ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος τῆς περιχώρου τῶν Γερασηνῶν ἀπελθεῖν ἀπ’ αὐτῶν, ὅτι φόβῳ μεγάλῳ συνείχοντο· αὐτὸς δὲ ἐμβὰς εἰς πλοῖον ὑπέστρεψεν.

records.literal_gloss: And asked him all the multitude of the surrounding region of the Gerasenes to go away from them, because with fear great they were gripped; and he, having gotten into a boat, returned.

en.L: And all the multitude of the surrounding region of the Gerasenes asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to go away from them, because they were gripped by great fear; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, getting into a boat, returned.
en.B: Then the whole population of the Gerasene region asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to leave them, because a great fear had taken hold of them. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} got into the boat and went back.
en.R: Then all the people who lived in the area asked Jesus to leave, because they were very afraid. So Jesus got into the boat and went back across the lake.

es.L: Y toda la multitud de la región de alrededor de los gerasenos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pidió que se fuera de ellos, porque estaban dominados por un gran temor; y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, subiendo a una barca, regresó.
es.B: Entonces toda la gente de la región de los gerasenos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pidió que se marchara de allí, porque un gran temor se había apoderado de ellos. Así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} subió a la barca y se volvió.
es.R: Entonces toda la gente que vivía en esa zona le pidió a Jesús que se fuera, porque tenían mucho miedo. Así que Jesús subió a la barca y volvió al otro lado del lago.

fr.L: Et toute la multitude de la région environnante des Géraséniens {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanda de s’en aller de chez eux, parce qu’ils étaient saisis d’une grande crainte ; et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, étant monté dans une barque, s’en retourna.
fr.B: Alors toute la population de la région des Géraséniens {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanda de s’éloigner d’eux, car une grande frayeur s’était emparée d’eux. Il monta donc dans la barque et s’en retourna.
fr.R: Alors tous les gens de la région ont demandé à Jésus de partir, parce qu’ils avaient très peur. Jésus est donc remonté dans le bateau, et il est reparti de l’autre côté du lac.

sw.L: Na watu wote wa nchi ya kandokando ya Wagerasi walimwomba aondoke kwao, kwa sababu walikuwa wameshikwa na hofu kuu; {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, akiingia katika mashua, akarudi.
sw.B: Kisha watu wote wa nchi ya Wagerasi walimwomba aondoke kwao, kwa sababu hofu kuu ilikuwa imewashika. Basi akaingia katika mashua, akarudi.
sw.R: Kisha watu wote walioishi katika eneo lile walimwomba Yesu aondoke, kwa sababu waliogopa sana. Basi Yesu aliingia katika mashua, akarudi ng'ambo ya ziwa.

ko.L: 그러자 거라사 사람들의 주변 지방의 온 무리가 자기들에게서 떠나 달라고 그분께 요청했다. 그들이 큰 두려움에 사로잡혔기 때문이다. 그래서 그분은 배에 올라 돌아가셨다.
ko.B: 그러자 거라사 지방의 모든 사람이 자기들에게서 떠나 달라고 예수께 요청했다. 큰 두려움이 그들을 사로잡았기 때문이다. 그래서 예수께서는 배에 오르셔서 돌아가셨다.
ko.R: 그러자 그 지방에 사는 사람들이 모두 예수께 자기들 땅에서 떠나 달라고 했다. 그들은 몹시 무서웠다. 그래서 예수께서는 배를 타시고 호수 건너편으로 돌아가셨다.

vi.L: Và toàn thể dân chúng ở vùng chung quanh xứ người Giê-ra-sê xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi họ, vì họ bị nỗi sợ hãi lớn bao trùm; còn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bước xuống thuyền và trở về.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toàn thể dân chúng trong vùng người Giê-ra-sê xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi đó, vì họ quá sợ hãi. Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xuống thuyền trở về.
vi.R: Rồi tất cả dân chúng trong vùng ấy xin Đức Giê-xu rời khỏi đó, vì họ rất sợ. Vậy Đức Giê-xu xuống thuyền và trở về bên kia hồ.

decisions.choice: Gerasenes: the reading of the SBLGNT, as in 8:26
decisions.reason: The manuscripts differ here in the same way as at 8:26. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: gripped by great fear: overwhelmed by fear
decisions.reason: The verb means to be held fast or seized. Their fear of Jesus's power outweighs their joy at the man's healing.

decisions.choice: he returned: he started back across the lake
alternatives: he went back to the town
decisions.reason: Luke finishes the scene here and tells of the arrival on the other side in 8:40.

decisions.choice: across the lake
decisions.reason: Readable says where he went back to.

source.text: ἐδεῖτο δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀφ’ οὗ ἐξεληλύθει τὰ δαιμόνια εἶναι σὺν αὐτῷ· ἀπέλυσεν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγων·

records.literal_gloss: Was begging then him the man from whom had gone out the demons to be with him; but he sent away him, saying:

en.L: But the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [that he might] be with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent him away, saying,
en.B: The man the demons had left kept begging to go with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but Jesus sent him away and said,
en.R: The man who had been freed from the demons begged Jesus to let him go along with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But Jesus sent him away. He said,

es.L: Y el hombre de quien habían salido los demonios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogaba [poder] estar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo despidió, diciendo:
es.B: El hombre del que habían salido los demonios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogaba que lo dejara ir con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, pero Jesús lo despidió diciendo:
es.R: El hombre que había quedado libre de los demonios le rogó a Jesús que lo dejara ir con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Pero Jesús lo despidió. Le dijo:

fr.L: Or l’homme dont les démons étaient sortis {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suppliait [de pouvoir] être avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le renvoya, disant :
fr.B: L’homme que les démons avaient quitté {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suppliait de le laisser partir avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, mais Jésus le renvoya en disant :
fr.R: L’homme qui avait été délivré des démons a supplié Jésus de le laisser partir avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Mais Jésus l’a renvoyé. Il lui a dit :

sw.L: Na yule mtu ambaye pepo walikuwa wamemtoka alikuwa akimsihi [ili] awe pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}; lakini alimruhusu aende zake, akisema,
sw.B: Yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo aliendelea kumsihi amruhusu aende pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, lakini Yesu alimuaga, akamwambia,
sw.R: Yule mtu aliyewekwa huru kutoka kwa pepo alimsihi Yesu amruhusu aende pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Lakini Yesu alimuaga aende zake. Alimwambia,

ko.L: 그런데 귀신들이 나간 그 사람이 그분과 함께 있게 해 달라고 그분께 간청하고 있었다. 그러나 그분은 그를 보내시며 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 귀신들이 나간 그 사람이 예수와 함께 가게 해 달라고 간청했다. 그러나 예수께서는 그를 돌려보내시며 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 귀신들에게서 풀려난 그 사람이 예수께 함께 가게 해 달라고 빌었다. 그러나 예수께서는 그를 돌려보내셨다. 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다.

vi.L: Người mà các quỷ đã ra khỏi nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho được ở với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho anh ta về, nói:
vi.B: Người mà các quỷ đã rời khỏi cứ nài xin được đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng Đức Giê-xu bảo anh ta về và nói:
vi.R: Người đã được giải thoát khỏi các quỷ van xin Đức Giê-xu cho anh ta đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhưng Đức Giê-xu bảo anh ta về. Ngài nói:

decisions.choice: to be with him: to go with Jesus as one of his companions
alternatives: to stay near him for a while
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used of the twelve who traveled with Jesus (8:1). The man asks to become one of his traveling followers (Mark 5:18).

decisions.choice: sent him away: dismissed him, with a task
decisions.reason: Jesus does not reject him. He sends him back with work to do (8:39).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus, since two men are in the sentence.

source.text: Ὑπόστρεφε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου, καὶ διηγοῦ ὅσα σοι ἐποίησεν ὁ θεός.

records.literal_gloss: Return to the house of you, and tell how much for you has done God.

en.L: "Return to your house, and describe how much God has done for you."
en.B: "Go back home and tell the story of everything God has done for you."
en.R: "Go back home. Tell your family and friends all the things that God has done for you."

es.L: «Vuelve a tu casa y cuenta cuánto ha hecho Dios por ti».
es.B: «Vuelve a tu casa y cuenta todo lo que Dios ha hecho por ti».
es.R: «Vuelve a tu casa. Cuéntales a tu familia y a tus amigos todo lo que Dios ha hecho por ti».

fr.L: « Retourne dans ta maison, et raconte tout ce que Dieu a fait pour toi. »
fr.B: « Rentre chez toi et fais le récit de tout ce que Dieu a fait pour toi. »
fr.R: « Rentre chez toi. Raconte à ta famille et à tes amis toutes les choses que Dieu a faites pour toi. »

sw.L: "Rudi nyumbani kwako, ukasimulie yote ambayo Mungu amekutendea."
sw.B: "Rudi nyumbani, ukasimulie habari ya yote ambayo Mungu amekutendea."
sw.R: "Rudi nyumbani. Waeleze jamaa na rafiki zako mambo yote ambayo Mungu amekutendea."

ko.L: "네 집으로 돌아가서 하나님께서 너에게 얼마나 큰일을 하셨는지 이야기하여라."
ko.B: "집으로 돌아가서, 하나님께서 너에게 하신 모든 일을 이야기해 주어라."
ko.R: "집으로 돌아가거라. 가족과 친구들에게 하나님께서 너에게 해 주신 모든 일을 이야기해 주어라."

vi.L: "Hãy trở về nhà anh, và thuật lại mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho anh."
vi.B: "Hãy về nhà và kể lại mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho anh."
vi.R: "Hãy về nhà đi. Hãy kể cho gia đình và bạn bè anh nghe mọi việc Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho anh."

decisions.choice: house: home and household
decisions.reason: The word means both the house and the people in it.

decisions.choice: tell: give a full account
decisions.reason: The verb means to tell something in detail, from start to finish.

decisions.choice: your family and friends
decisions.reason: Readable says whom he was to tell, from the meaning of "house".

source.text: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν καθ’ ὅλην τὴν πόλιν κηρύσσων ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

records.literal_gloss: And he went away through all the city proclaiming how much had done for him Jesus.

en.L: And he went away through the whole city, proclaiming how much Jesus had done for him.
en.B: He went away and made known throughout the whole town everything Jesus had done for him.
en.R: So the man went all through the town. He told everyone what great things Jesus had done for him.

es.L: Y se fue por toda la ciudad, proclamando cuánto había hecho Jesús por él.
es.B: Él se fue y dio a conocer por todo el pueblo todo lo que Jesús había hecho por él.
es.R: Así que el hombre recorrió todo el pueblo. Les contaba a todos las grandes cosas que Jesús había hecho por él.

fr.L: Et il s’en alla par toute la ville, proclamant tout ce que Jésus avait fait pour lui.
fr.B: Il s’en alla et fit connaître dans toute la ville tout ce que Jésus avait fait pour lui.
fr.R: Alors l’homme est allé partout dans la ville. Il a raconté à tout le monde les grandes choses que Jésus avait faites pour lui.

sw.L: Naye akaenda zake katika mji wote, akitangaza yote ambayo Yesu alimtendea.
sw.B: Basi aliondoka, akatangaza katika mji wote mambo yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa amemtendea.
sw.R: Basi yule mtu alizunguka mji wote. Aliwaeleza watu wote mambo makuu ambayo Yesu alikuwa amemtendea.

ko.L: 그래서 그는 떠나가서, 예수께서 자기에게 얼마나 큰일을 하셨는지 온 고을에 선포했다.
ko.B: 그는 떠나가서, 예수께서 자기에게 하신 모든 일을 온 고을에 알렸다.
ko.R: 그래서 그 사람은 온 고을을 다녔다. 그리고 예수께서 자기에게 해 주신 큰일을 모든 사람에게 이야기했다.

vi.L: Và anh ta đi khắp thành, rao truyền mọi điều Đức Giê-xu đã làm cho mình.
vi.B: Anh ta ra đi và rao truyền khắp thị trấn mọi điều Đức Giê-xu đã làm cho mình.
vi.R: Vậy người ấy đi khắp thị trấn. Anh ta kể cho mọi người nghe Đức Giê-xu đã làm cho mình những việc lớn lao thế nào.

decisions.choice: God has done ... Jesus had done: what God did, he did through Jesus
decisions.reason: Jesus told him to tell what God had done (8:39); he tells what Jesus did. Luke puts the two side by side without comment: God was at work in Jesus (Acts 10:38).

decisions.choice: proclaiming: announcing publicly
decisions.reason: It is the word used for Jesus's own preaching (8:1). The man becomes a herald in a Gentile town.

decisions.choice: He told everyone
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what proclaiming meant.

decisions.choice: "하나님께서 ... 하신" (8:39a) and "예수께서 ... 하신" (8:39b) with the same verb at every level
alternatives: different verbs for the two sentences
decisions.reason: The meaning decision sees God's work done through Jesus in the change from "God" to "Jesus"; Korean keeps the two sentences parallel so the reader can see it.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời" in 8:39a and "Đức Giê-xu" here, kept apart
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says that what God did, he did through Jesus; every level keeps the two names as the Greek has them so the reader sees the link.

source.text: Ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑποστρέφειν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπεδέξατο αὐτὸν ὁ ὄχλος, ἦσαν γὰρ πάντες προσδοκῶντες αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: In then the returning [of] Jesus, welcomed him the crowd, they were for all waiting for him.

en.L: And when Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, for they were all waiting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: When Jesus came back across the lake, the people gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a warm welcome, for they had all been waiting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus went back across the lake. A crowd of people was there to welcome {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They had all been waiting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y al regresar Jesús, la multitud {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} recibió, porque todos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} estaban esperando.
es.B: Cuando Jesús regresó al otro lado del lago, la gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} recibió con alegría, porque todos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían estado esperando.
es.R: Jesús volvió al otro lado del lago. Había allí una multitud para recibirlo. Todos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían estado esperando.

fr.L: Et quand Jésus revint, la foule {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accueillit, car tous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendaient.
fr.B: Quand Jésus revint de l’autre côté du lac, la foule {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accueillit avec joie, car tous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendaient.
fr.R: Jésus est revenu de l’autre côté du lac. Une foule de gens était là pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accueillir. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendaient tous.

sw.L: Na Yesu aliporudi, umati ulimkaribisha, kwa maana wote walikuwa wakimngoja.
sw.B: Yesu aliporudi ng'ambo ya ziwa, watu walimkaribisha kwa furaha, kwa maana wote walikuwa wakimngoja.
sw.R: Yesu alirudi ng'ambo ya ziwa. Umati wa watu ulikuwa pale kumkaribisha. Wote walikuwa wakimngoja.

ko.L: 예수께서 돌아오시자 무리가 그분을 환영했다. 모두가 그분을 기다리고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 호수 건너편에서 돌아오시자, 무리가 예수를 반갑게 맞이했다. 모두가 예수를 기다리고 있었던 것이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 호수를 건너 돌아오셨다. 많은 사람들이 예수를 반갑게 맞이했다. 그들은 모두 예수를 기다리고 있었다.

vi.L: Và khi Đức Giê-xu trở về, đoàn dân đón tiếp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì mọi người đều đang trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi Đức Giê-xu trở lại bờ bên kia hồ, dân chúng vui mừng đón tiếp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì mọi người đều đã trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đi thuyền trở về bên kia hồ. Ở đó có một đám đông đang chờ đón {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mọi người đều đã trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: welcomed: received gladly
decisions.reason: The verb means to receive someone gladly. The welcome stands in contrast with the Gerasenes, who asked him to leave (8:37).

decisions.choice: returned: came back to the western shore, in Galilee
decisions.reason: This is the return from the voyage that began in 8:37.

decisions.choice: across the lake
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say where he came back from.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν ἀνὴρ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰάϊρος, καὶ οὗτος ἄρχων τῆς συναγωγῆς ὑπῆρχεν, καὶ πεσὼν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι θυγάτηρ μονογενὴς ἦν αὐτῷ ὡς ἐτῶν δώδεκα καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπέθνῃσκεν.

records.literal_gloss: And look, came a man whose name [was] Jairus, and this [man] a ruler of the synagogue was, and having fallen at the feet of Jesus he was begging him to come into the house of him, \v 42 because daughter only was to him about years twelve, and she was dying.

en.L: And look, a man came whose name [was] Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue; and falling at the feet of Jesus, he was begging {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to come into his house, \v 42 because he had an only daughter, about twelve years [old], and she was dying.
en.B: Then a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. Throwing himself down at the feet of Jesus, he begged {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to come to his home, \v 42 because his only child, a daughter about twelve years old, lay dying.
en.R: Then a man named Jairus came. He was a leader in the synagogue. He bowed down at the feet of Jesus and begged {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to come to his house. \v 42 His only daughter was dying. She was about twelve years old.

es.L: Y mira, vino un hombre cuyo nombre [era] Jairo, y este era jefe de la sinagoga; y cayendo a los pies de Jesús, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogaba que entrara en su casa, \v 42 porque tenía una hija única, de unos doce años, y ella se estaba muriendo.
es.B: Entonces llegó un hombre llamado Jairo, que era jefe de la sinagoga. Se echó a los pies de Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogó que fuera a su casa, \v 42 porque su única hija, una niña de unos doce años, se estaba muriendo.
es.R: Entonces llegó un hombre llamado Jairo. Era uno de los jefes de la sinagoga. Se arrodilló a los pies de Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogó que fuera a su casa. \v 42 Su única hija se estaba muriendo. Tenía unos doce años.

fr.L: Et voici, vint un homme dont le nom [était] Jaïre, et celui-ci était chef de la synagogue ; et, tombant aux pieds de Jésus, il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suppliait d’entrer dans sa maison, \v 42 parce qu’il avait une fille unique d’environ douze ans, et elle se mourait.
fr.B: Alors arriva un homme nommé Jaïre, qui était chef de la synagogue. Il se jeta aux pieds de Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplia de venir chez lui, \v 42 car sa fille unique, qui avait environ douze ans, était mourante.
fr.R: Alors un homme appelé Jaïre est arrivé. C’était un responsable de la synagogue. Il s’est mis à genoux aux pieds de Jésus et il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a supplié de venir dans sa maison. \v 42 Sa fille unique était en train de mourir. Elle avait environ douze ans.

sw.L: Na tazama, alikuja mtu jina lake Yairo, naye huyu alikuwa mkuu wa sinagogi; na akianguka miguuni pa Yesu, alikuwa akimsihi aingie nyumbani kwake, \v 42 kwa sababu alikuwa na binti wa pekee, mwenye umri wa miaka kama kumi na miwili, naye alikuwa akifa.
sw.B: Kisha akaja mtu mmoja aitwaye Yairo, kiongozi wa sinagogi. Alijitupa miguuni pa Yesu, akamsihi aje nyumbani kwake, \v 42 kwa sababu binti yake wa pekee, mwenye umri wa miaka kama kumi na miwili, alikuwa karibu kufa.
sw.R: Kisha mtu mmoja aitwaye Yairo alikuja. Alikuwa kiongozi katika sinagogi. Alipiga magoti miguuni pa Yesu, akamsihi aje nyumbani kwake. \v 42 Binti yake wa pekee alikuwa anakufa. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka kama kumi na miwili.

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 이름이 야이로라는 사람이 왔다. 이 사람은 회당장이었다. 그는 예수의 발 앞에 엎드려 자기 집에 들어와 주시기를 그분께 간청하고 있었다. \v 42 그에게 열두 살쯤 된 외동딸이 있었는데, 그 아이가 죽어 가고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그때 야이로라는 사람이 왔다. 그는 회당장이었다. 그는 예수의 발 앞에 엎드려 자기 집에 와 주십사고 간청했다. \v 42 그에게는 열두 살쯤 된 외동딸이 있었는데, 그 딸이 죽어 가고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그때 야이로라는 사람이 왔다. 그는 회당을 이끄는 지도자였다. 그는 예수의 발 앞에 엎드려 자기 집에 와 달라고 간절히 부탁드렸다. \v 42 그의 하나뿐인 딸이 죽어 가고 있었다. 딸은 열두 살쯤 되었다.

vi.L: Và kìa, có một người tên là Giai-ru đến, ông là người lãnh đạo nhà hội; và sấp mình dưới chân Đức Giê-xu, ông nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào nhà mình, \v 42 vì ông có một con gái duy nhất, khoảng mười hai tuổi, và cô đang hấp hối.
vi.B: Bấy giờ có một người tên là Giai-ru đến. Ông là người lãnh đạo nhà hội. Ông sấp mình dưới chân Đức Giê-xu, nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến nhà mình, \v 42 vì đứa con duy nhất của ông, một bé gái khoảng mười hai tuổi, đang hấp hối.
vi.R: Rồi có một người tên là Giai-ru đến. Ông là một người lãnh đạo nhà hội. Ông quỳ xuống dưới chân Đức Giê-xu và nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến nhà mình. \v 42 Con gái duy nhất của ông đang sắp chết. Cô bé khoảng mười hai tuổi.

decisions.choice: ruler of the synagogue: the leader who was in charge of the synagogue's meetings
decisions.reason: He arranged the worship and chose who would read and speak (Acts 13:15). He was a respected man in the town.

decisions.choice: falling at the feet of Jesus: humble, public pleading
decisions.reason: An important man lowers himself before Jesus in front of the crowd, as a desperate father.

decisions.choice: only: his only child
alternatives: his only daughter among several children
decisions.reason: The same word is used of the widow's only son (7:12) and of the boy in 9:38. Luke notes it each time, which makes the loss greater.

decisions.choice: she was dying: at the point of death
decisions.reason: The tense describes something in progress. She dies before Jesus arrives (8:49).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: a leader in the synagogue
decisions.reason: Readable uses a more familiar word for his position.

decisions.choice: mira (L); not translated (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering of "look": the everyday "mirar" at Literal, singular because Luke speaks to the reader; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: jefe de la sinagoga (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering for the leader in charge of the synagogue's meetings (meaning decision m1), kept at Readable too where the English says "a leader". The same in verse 49.

decisions.choice: voici (L)
decisions.reason: French "voici" is the ordinary word that points to what follows and has none of the old-fashioned ring of English "behold", so Literal can use it where English Literal says "look"; an imperative "regarde" would sound like a command to the reader.

decisions.choice: tazama (L); not translated (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering of "look", singular because Luke speaks to the reader; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mkuu wa sinagogi (L); kiongozi wa sinagogi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The man in charge of the synagogue's meetings (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "mkuu" (head) for the Greek title; Balanced and Readable say "kiongozi" (leader), the everyday word, as the term sheet settles and as in Mark 5:22. The same in verse 49.

decisions.choice: "회당장" (L, B); "회당을 이끄는 지도자" (R); "야이로", as in Mark 5:22
decisions.reason: The synoptic parallel keeps the Korean Mark's words.

decisions.choice: "보아라" (L) for idou; not rendered (B, R), as at Luke 5:12
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word that draws attention; Balanced and Readable let "그때" carry it.

decisions.choice: "Giai-ru"; "người lãnh đạo nhà hội"; "kìa" (L) only
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:22: the Protestant form of the name and the plain modern word for the man in charge of the synagogue's meetings (meaning decision). Literal keeps the Greek "look" as "kìa"; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

source.text: Ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑπάγειν αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι συνέπνιγον αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: In then the going [of] him, the crowds were pressing around him.

en.L: And as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went, the crowds were pressing in on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way there, the crowds were jammed tightly around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: As Jesus went with Jairus, crowds of people pushed against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from every side.

es.L: Y mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} iba, las multitudes {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} apretujaban.
es.B: Mientras se dirigía allá, las multitudes se apiñaban a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor.
es.R: Mientras Jesús iba con Jairo, mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} empujaba por todos lados.

fr.L: Et pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’y rendait, les foules {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}étouffaient.
fr.B: Pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’y rendait, les foules se pressaient autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}étouffer.
fr.R: Pendant que Jésus allait avec Jaïre, beaucoup de gens {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} poussaient de tous les côtés.

sw.L: Na alipokuwa akienda, makundi ya watu yalikuwa yakimsonga.
sw.B: Alipokuwa akienda huko, makundi ya watu yalimsongasonga pande zote.
sw.R: Yesu alipokuwa akienda pamoja na Yairo, makundi ya watu yalimsukuma kutoka kila upande.

ko.L: 그런데 그분이 가실 때에 무리가 그분을 숨 막히게 밀어 대고 있었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 가시는 동안, 무리가 예수를 빽빽이 에워싸고 밀어 댔다.
ko.R: 예수께서 야이로와 함께 가셨다. 많은 사람들이 사방에서 예수를 밀어 댔다.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đi, các đoàn dân chen lấn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi đến đó, dân chúng chen chúc quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến nghẹt thở.
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu đi với Giai-ru, rất đông người chen lấn, xô đẩy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ mọi phía.

decisions.choice: were pressing around: crowding so close that they almost crushed him
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the thorns choking the seed (8:14). The crowd is so thick that no one can tell who touched him (8:45).

decisions.choice: Jesus went with Jairus
decisions.reason: Readable names both men.

decisions.choice: étouffaient (L); se pressaient autour de lui à l’étouffer (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the thorns that choke the seed in 8:14 (m1: crowding so close that they almost crushed him). French "étouffer" carries both, so Literal and Balanced keep the echo; Readable says simply that the people pushed him.

decisions.choice: "숨 막히게 밀어 대다" (L) for synepnigon
decisions.reason: Luke uses the verb of the thorns that choke the seed (8:14); Literal keeps the picture of crushing.

source.text: καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος ἀπὸ ἐτῶν δώδεκα, ἥτις ἰατροῖς προσαναλώσασα ὅλον τὸν βίον οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἀπ’ οὐδενὸς θεραπευθῆναι, προσελθοῦσα ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ, καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔστη ἡ ῥύσις τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: And a woman being in a flow of blood for years twelve, who on physicians having spent all the living, not was able by anyone to be healed, \v 44 having come behind touched the fringe of the cloak of him, and immediately stopped the flow of the blood of her.

en.L: And a woman who had been in a flow of blood for twelve years, who, having spent her whole living on physicians, was not able to be healed by anyone, \v 44 came up behind and touched the fringe of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} garment, and immediately her flow of blood stopped.
en.B: Among them was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could cure her. \v 44 Coming up behind Jesus, she touched the tassel on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} cloak, and her bleeding stopped at once.
en.R: A woman there had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on doctors, but no one could heal her. \v 44 She came up behind Jesus and touched the tassel on the edge of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} robe. Right away her bleeding stopped.

es.L: Y una mujer que estaba con flujo de sangre desde hacía doce años, la cual, habiendo gastado en médicos todo su sustento, no había podido ser sanada por nadie, \v 44 acercándose por detrás, tocó el fleco de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} manto, y al instante se detuvo su flujo de sangre.
es.B: Entre ellos había una mujer que llevaba doce años con hemorragias. Había gastado todo lo que tenía en médicos, pero ninguno había podido curarla. \v 44 Se acercó a Jesús por detrás y tocó la borla de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} manto, y al instante se le detuvo la hemorragia.
es.R: Allí había una mujer que llevaba doce años sangrando. Había gastado todo su dinero en médicos, pero nadie la había podido sanar. \v 44 Se acercó a Jesús por detrás y tocó la borla del borde de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ropa. En seguida dejó de sangrar.

fr.L: Et une femme qui avait une perte de sang depuis douze ans, qui, ayant dépensé tout son bien pour des médecins, n’avait pu être guérie par personne, \v 44 s’approcha par-derrière et toucha la frange de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vêtement, et à l’instant sa perte de sang s’arrêta.
fr.B: Parmi eux se trouvait une femme qui perdait du sang depuis douze ans. Elle avait dépensé tout ce qu’elle avait pour des médecins, mais aucun n’avait pu la guérir. \v 44 Elle s’approcha de Jésus par-derrière et toucha la frange de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} manteau ; aussitôt, sa perte de sang s’arrêta.
fr.R: Une femme était là. Elle saignait depuis douze ans. Elle avait dépensé tout son argent chez les médecins, mais personne n’avait pu la guérir. \v 44 Elle s’est approchée de Jésus par-derrière, et elle a touché la frange au bord de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} manteau. Tout de suite, elle a arrêté de saigner.

sw.L: Na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na ugonjwa wa kutokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili, ambaye, akiisha kutumia riziki yake yote kwa matabibu, hakuweza kuponywa na mtu yeyote, \v 44 alikuja kwa nyuma, akagusa pindo la vazi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, na mara moja kutokwa damu kwake kukakoma.
sw.B: Kati yao alikuwemo mwanamke aliyekuwa akitokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili. Alikuwa ametumia mali yake yote kwa matabibu, lakini hakuna aliyeweza kumponya. \v 44 Alikuja nyuma ya Yesu, akagusa kishada cha joho {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, na mara damu yake ikaacha kutoka.
sw.R: Pale palikuwa na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa akitokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili. Alikuwa ametumia fedha zake zote kwa madaktari, lakini hakuna aliyeweza kumponya. \v 44 Alikuja nyuma ya Yesu, akagusa kishada kilichokuwa kwenye pindo la nguo {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Mara moja damu ikaacha kutoka.

ko.L: 그리고 열두 해 동안 피가 흐르는 [병을] 앓고 있던 한 여자가 있었는데, 그는 의사들에게 생활비를 다 쓰고도 아무에게서도 고침을 받을 수 없었다. \v 44 그 여자가 뒤로 다가와서 그분의 겉옷 술을 만지자, 곧 그 여자의 피의 흐름이 멈추었다.
ko.B: 그 가운데 열두 해 동안 하혈하는 병을 앓아 온 여자가 있었다. 그 여자는 가진 것을 의사들에게 다 써 버렸지만, 아무도 그 여자를 고치지 못했다. \v 44 그 여자가 예수의 뒤로 다가와서 겉옷 술을 만지자, 곧바로 피가 멎었다.
ko.R: 그곳에 열두 해 동안 피가 멈추지 않는 병을 앓아 온 여자가 있었다. 그 여자는 가진 돈을 의사들에게 다 써 버렸지만, 아무도 그 병을 고치지 못했다. \v 44 여자는 예수의 뒤로 다가가서 예수의 옷자락 끝에 달린 술을 만졌다. 그러자 바로 피가 멈추었다.

vi.L: Và một người phụ nữ bị ra huyết đã mười hai năm, là người đã tiêu hết mọi của cải mình có cho các thầy thuốc mà không ai chữa lành được, \v 44 đến phía sau [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] và chạm vào tua áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và lập tức sự ra huyết của bà ngừng lại.
vi.B: Trong đám đông có một người phụ nữ bị bệnh rong huyết đã mười hai năm. Bà đã tiêu hết tiền của cho các thầy thuốc, nhưng không ai chữa lành được. \v 44 Bà đến phía sau Đức Giê-xu và chạm vào tua áo choàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và lập tức máu cầm lại.
vi.R: Ở đó có một người phụ nữ bị bệnh ra máu đã mười hai năm. Bà đã tiêu hết tiền bạc vào việc chữa bệnh, nhưng không ai chữa khỏi cho bà. \v 44 Bà đến phía sau Đức Giê-xu và chạm vào mép áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngay lập tức, máu cầm lại.

decisions.choice: who had spent all her living on physicians: in the SBLGNT
alternatives: the words are missing in some early manuscripts
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts have these words, but some important early ones lack them. They may have been added from Mark 5:26, which tells of her many doctors in other words, or they may be original. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a flow of blood: bleeding that made her unclean under the law
decisions.reason: A woman with a long flow of blood was unclean, and so was anything she touched (Leviticus 15:25-27). For twelve years she had been kept apart from worship and from close contact with others. That is why she came up from behind.

decisions.choice: fringe: the tassel on the corner of his cloak
alternatives: the hem along the bottom edge
decisions.reason: The law told Israelites to wear tassels on the corners of their garments as a reminder of God's commands (Numbers 15:38-39; Deuteronomy 22:12). Jesus wore them as a faithful Jew.

decisions.choice: living: all she had to live on
decisions.reason: The word means a person's means of living, as in 15:12 and 21:4.

decisions.choice: tassel
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the tassel, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whom she came up behind.

decisions.choice: el fleco (L); la borla (B, R)
decisions.reason: The tassel worn on the corner of the cloak (meaning decision m3). Literal says "fleco", as the English says "fringe"; Balanced and Readable name the "borla", the tassel itself, as the English does. "El borde" alone would lose it.

decisions.choice: la frange
decisions.reason: English Balanced and Readable say "tassel" (m3). French "houppe" is rare and "gland" or "pompon" are furnishing words; "la frange" is the ordinary word for the threads that hang from the edge of a garment, so it serves at every level, and Readable adds "au bord" to say where it hung.

decisions.choice: matabibu (L, B); madaktari (R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering. "Waganga" today often means traditional healers, which would add a picture the Greek does not have; Readable uses the everyday "daktari", as in Mark 5:26.

decisions.choice: pindo la vazi (L); kishada cha joho (B); kishada ... pindo la nguo (R)
decisions.reason: The tassel on the corner of the cloak (meaning decision m3). Literal says "pindo" (fringe), as the English does; Balanced and Readable name the "kishada", the tassel itself. "Joho" is the long outer robe, and Readable says simply "nguo", as in Mark 5:27.

decisions.choice: "피가 흐르는 [병을] 앓다" (L); "하혈하는 병" (B); "피가 멈추지 않는 병" (R), as in Mark 5:25
decisions.reason: The synoptic parallel keeps the Korean Mark's words; "혈루증" is the word of familiar versions and is not current Korean.

decisions.choice: "술" for kraspedon (the tassel); "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for parachrēma (8:44, 8:47, 8:55)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the fringe as the tassel on the cloak's corner; Korean "술" names it. Luke's "immediately" takes the words set for Mark's euthys, as at Luke 5:13.

decisions.choice: "ra huyết" (L); "bệnh rong huyết" (B); "bệnh ra máu" (R); "tua áo" (L, B), "mép áo" (R); "bà" for the woman
decisions.reason: As in the parallels Mark 5:25 and Matthew 9:20, for the same illness, the same tassel and the same woman.

decisions.choice: "lập tức" (L, B); "ngay lập tức" (R) for Luke's "immediately" (also 8:47, 8:55)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 4:39 and 5:13: the settled word where a healing takes effect at once.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τίς ὁ ἁψάμενός μου;

records.literal_gloss: And said Jesus: Who [is] the [one] having touched me?

en.L: And Jesus said, "Who [is] the one who touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"
en.B: Jesus asked, "Who touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"
en.R: Jesus asked, "Who touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"

es.L: Y Jesús dijo: «¿Quién [es] el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó?».
es.B: Jesús preguntó: «¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó?».
es.R: Jesús preguntó: «¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó?».

fr.L: Et Jésus dit : « Qui [est] celui qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché ? »
fr.B: Jésus demanda : « Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché ? »
fr.R: Jésus a demandé : « Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché ? »

sw.L: Naye Yesu akasema, "[Ni] nani aliyenigusa?"
sw.B: Yesu aliuliza, "Ni nani aliyenigusa?"
sw.R: Yesu aliuliza, "Ni nani aliyenigusa?"

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "나를 만진 사람이 누구냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 물으셨다. "누가 나를 만졌느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 물으셨다. "누가 나를 만졌느냐?"

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói: "Ai là người đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu hỏi: "Ai đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu hỏi: "Ai đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"

decisions.choice: who touched me: a real question, which brings the healing into the open
decisions.reason: Jesus asks so that the woman will come forward (8:47). Her healing is not to stay a secret.

source.text: ἀρνουμένων δὲ πάντων εἶπεν ὁ Πέτρος· Ἐπιστάτα, οἱ ὄχλοι συνέχουσίν σε καὶ ἀποθλίβουσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Denying then all, said Peter: Master, the crowds are hemming in you and pressing.

en.L: And when all were denying [it], Peter said, "Master, the crowds are hemming {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in and pressing [against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}]."
en.B: Everyone denied it, and Peter said, "Master, the crowds are hemming {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in and pushing against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"
en.R: Everyone said they had not touched {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then Peter said, "Master, all these people are pushing and crowding against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"

es.L: Y como todos lo negaban, dijo Pedro: «Maestro, las multitudes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodean y [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] aprietan».
es.B: Todos lo negaban, y Pedro dijo: «Maestro, las multitudes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodean y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} empujan».
es.R: Todos dijeron que no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían tocado. Entonces Pedro dijo: «Maestro, ¡toda esta gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} está empujando y apretando!».

fr.L: Et comme tous niaient, Pierre dit : « Maître, les foules {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}entourent et [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] pressent. »
fr.B: Comme tous niaient, Pierre dit : « Maître, les foules {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}entourent et {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bousculent ! »
fr.R: Tout le monde a affirmé ne pas {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avoir touché. Alors Pierre a dit : « Maître, tous ces gens {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} poussent et se serrent contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! »

sw.L: Na wote walipokuwa wakikana, Petro akasema, "Mkuu, makundi ya watu yanakuzunguka na kukusonga."
sw.B: Wote walipokana, Petro alisema, "Mkuu, makundi ya watu yanakuzunguka na kukusukuma!"
sw.R: Kila mtu alisema hakumgusa. Kisha Petro akasema, "Mkuu, watu wote hawa wanakusukuma na kukusonga!"

ko.L: 모두가 아니라고 하자 베드로가 말했다. "선생님, 무리가 선생님을 에워싸고 밀어 대고 있습니다."
ko.B: 모두 아니라고 하자 베드로가 말했다. "선생님, 무리가 선생님을 둘러싸고 밀어 대고 있습니다!"
ko.R: 모두 자기는 만지지 않았다고 했다. 그러자 베드로가 말했다. "선생님, 이 많은 사람들이 사방에서 선생님을 밀어 대고 있습니다!"

vi.L: Khi mọi người đều chối, Phi-e-rơ nói: "Thưa Thầy, các đoàn dân đang vây quanh Thầy và chen lấn [Thầy]."
vi.B: Ai cũng chối, nên Phi-e-rơ thưa: "Thưa Thầy, dân chúng đang vây kín và chen lấn Thầy!"
vi.R: Mọi người đều nói mình không chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Phi-e-rơ thưa: "Thưa Thầy, bao nhiêu người đang chen lấn, xô đẩy Thầy!"

decisions.choice: Peter ... pressing: the shorter reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: Peter and those with him ... pressing, and you say, 'Who touched me?'
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "and those with him" after Peter's name and end his words with "and you say, 'Who touched me?'", as in Mark 5:31. Several early manuscripts have the shorter text. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Master: the disciples' word for Jesus
decisions.reason: As at 5:5 and 8:24.

decisions.choice: hemming in and pressing: surrounding and squeezing
decisions.reason: Peter means that with so many people pressing on Jesus, it makes no sense to ask who touched him.

decisions.choice: said they had not touched him
decisions.reason: Readable says what they denied.

decisions.choice: Peter speaks in 합쇼체 and says "선생님" both for epistata and for "you"
decisions.reason: As at Luke 5:5 and Mark 5:31 in Korean; the noun stands for the pronoun, so Literal does not bracket it.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy" and "Thầy" for "you", with no setting span
decisions.reason: Luke's word "Master" as in 8:24; "Thầy" is a noun of address and takes no span where the English has one.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἥψατό μού τις, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔγνων δύναμιν ἐξεληλυθυῖαν ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: But Jesus said: Touched me someone, I for knew power having gone out from me.

en.L: But Jesus said, "Someone touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, for I perceived power going out from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: But Jesus said, "Someone did touch {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I felt power go out from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: But Jesus said, "Someone touched {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I know it, because I felt power go out of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Pero Jesús dijo: «Alguien {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó, porque yo percibí que un poder salía de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.B: Pero Jesús dijo: «Alguien sí {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó. Sentí que de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} salía poder».
es.R: Pero Jesús dijo: «Alguien {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tocó. Lo sé porque sentí que salió poder de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».

fr.L: Mais Jésus dit : « Quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché, car j’ai perçu qu’une puissance était sortie de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: Mais Jésus dit : « Quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a bel et bien touché. J’ai senti qu’une puissance était sortie de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: Mais Jésus a dit : « Quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a touché. Je le sais, parce que j’ai senti une force sortir de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »

sw.L: Lakini Yesu akasema, "Mtu fulani amenigusa, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimetambua nguvu ikinitoka."
sw.B: Lakini Yesu alisema, "Kuna mtu aliyenigusa kweli. Nimehisi nguvu ikinitoka."
sw.R: Lakini Yesu alisema, "Mtu fulani amenigusa. Najua hivyo kwa sababu nimehisi nguvu ikinitoka."

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "누군가가 나를 만졌다. 내게서 능력이 나간 것을 내가 알았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "누군가가 나를 만졌다. 내게서 능력이 나간 것을 내가 느꼈다."
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "누군가가 나를 만졌다. 내게서 능력이 나간 것을 느꼈기 때문에 나는 그것을 안다."

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói: "Có người đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết có quyền năng đã ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói: "Có người đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thật. Ta cảm thấy có quyền năng ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói: "Có người đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta biết vậy, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cảm thấy có quyền năng đã ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

decisions.choice: power: God's power to heal, at work in Jesus
decisions.reason: Luke says that the Lord's power was with Jesus to heal (5:17) and that power came out from him and healed all (6:19).

decisions.choice: I perceived: I became aware
decisions.reason: The verb means to know or recognize. Jesus noticed the healing as it happened.

decisions.choice: I felt
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how he knew.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} (L)
decisions.reason: The English "I" takes no setting. Literal keeps the Greek's separate "I" as the free pronoun "mimi", which Swahili spans when Jesus speaks of himself, as its style guide settles; Balanced and Readable leave it in the verb, as Swahili usually does.

source.text: ἰδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γυνὴ ὅτι οὐκ ἔλαθεν τρέμουσα ἦλθεν καὶ προσπεσοῦσα αὐτῷ δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἥψατο αὐτοῦ ἀπήγγειλεν ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ὡς ἰάθη παραχρῆμα.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then the woman that not she escaped notice, trembling she came and having fallen down before him, for what reason she touched him she declared before all the people, and how she was healed immediately.

en.L: And the woman, seeing that she had not escaped notice, came trembling, and falling down before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, she declared in the presence of all the people for what reason she had touched {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and how she had been healed immediately.
en.B: Realizing that she had been found out, the woman came forward, shaking, and threw herself down before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. With all the people listening, she explained her reason for touching {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and told how she had been healed on the spot.
en.R: The woman knew that she could not hide. She came forward, shaking with fear, and bowed down in front of Jesus. With everyone listening, she told why she had touched {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. She told how she had been healed right away.

es.L: Y la mujer, viendo que no había pasado inadvertida, vino temblando, y postrándose ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, declaró delante de todo el pueblo por qué causa {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había tocado, y cómo había sido sanada al instante.
es.B: Al darse cuenta de que la habían descubierto, la mujer se acercó temblando y se postró ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Delante de toda la gente explicó por qué {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había tocado y contó cómo había quedado sana en ese mismo momento.
es.R: La mujer supo que no podía esconderse. Se acercó temblando de miedo y se arrodilló delante de Jesús. Delante de todos, contó por qué {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había tocado. Contó también cómo había quedado sana enseguida.

fr.L: Et la femme, voyant qu’elle n’était pas passée inaperçue, vint en tremblant, et, tombant devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, elle déclara devant tout le peuple pour quelle raison elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait touché, et comment elle avait été guérie à l’instant.
fr.B: Se voyant découverte, la femme s’avança toute tremblante et se jeta à terre devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Devant tout le peuple, elle expliqua pourquoi elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait touché et comment elle avait été guérie sur-le-champ.
fr.R: La femme a compris qu’elle ne pouvait pas se cacher. Elle s’est avancée en tremblant de peur, et elle s’est mise à genoux devant Jésus. Devant tout le monde, elle a dit pourquoi elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait touché. Elle a raconté comment elle avait été guérie tout de suite.

sw.L: Na yule mwanamke, alipoona kwamba hakujificha, alikuja akitetemeka, na akianguka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, alieleza mbele ya watu wote sababu iliyomfanya amguse, na jinsi alivyoponywa mara moja.
sw.B: Yule mwanamke alipotambua kwamba amegunduliwa, alikuja akitetemeka, akajitupa chini mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Mbele ya watu wote alieleza sababu ya kumgusa, na jinsi alivyoponywa papo hapo.
sw.R: Yule mwanamke alijua kwamba hawezi kujificha. Alikuja mbele akitetemeka kwa hofu, akapiga magoti mbele ya Yesu. Watu wote wakisikiliza, alieleza kwa nini alimgusa. Alieleza jinsi alivyoponywa mara moja.

ko.L: 그 여자는 자기가 숨을 수 없음을 알고, 떨면서 와서 그분 앞에 엎드려, 무슨 까닭으로 그분을 만졌는지, 그리고 어떻게 곧 나았는지 모든 백성 앞에서 말씀드렸다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 더 이상 숨을 수 없다는 것을 알고, 떨면서 나아와 예수 앞에 엎드렸다. 그리고 모든 사람이 듣는 앞에서, 왜 예수를 만졌는지와 어떻게 곧바로 나았는지를 말씀드렸다.
ko.R: 여자는 이제 숨을 수 없다는 것을 알았다. 그래서 무서워 떨면서 나아와 예수 앞에 엎드렸다. 그리고 모든 사람이 듣는 데서, 왜 예수를 만졌는지 말씀드렸다. 또 어떻게 바로 병이 나았는지도 말씀드렸다.

vi.L: Thấy mình không giấu được, người phụ nữ run rẩy đến sấp mình trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và trước mặt cả dân chúng, bà kể lại vì lý do gì bà đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và bà đã được chữa lành lập tức thể nào.
vi.B: Biết mình không thể giấu được, người phụ nữ run rẩy bước ra, sấp mình trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Trước mặt mọi người, bà kể lại lý do mình đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và mình đã được lành lập tức thế nào.
vi.R: Người phụ nữ biết mình không thể giấu được nữa. Bà run sợ bước ra và quỳ xuống trước mặt Đức Giê-xu. Trước mặt mọi người, bà kể tại sao mình đã chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Bà cũng kể mình đã được lành bệnh ngay lập tức thế nào.

decisions.choice: trembling: afraid because of what she had done
decisions.reason: She had touched a teacher while she was unclean (Leviticus 15:25-27), and now she had to admit it in public.

decisions.choice: she had not escaped notice: she could not stay hidden
decisions.reason: The verb means to go unnoticed. Jesus's question (8:45-46) had made it clear that he knew.

decisions.choice: she declared before all the people: her healing is made public
decisions.reason: The woman who had been kept apart now speaks before everyone. All can hear that she is clean and whole.

decisions.choice: with fear
decisions.reason: Readable says why she was shaking, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "말씀드리다" for her report to Jesus
decisions.reason: She speaks to Jesus, so Korean uses the humble verb, as in Mark 5:33.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Θυγάτηρ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε· πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην.

records.literal_gloss: And he said to her: Daughter, the faith of you has saved you; go into peace.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to her, "Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace."
en.B: Jesus said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace."
en.R: Jesus said to her, "My daughter, your faith has made you well and saved you. Go in peace."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le dijo: «Hija, tu fe te ha salvado; vete en paz».
es.B: Jesús le dijo: «Hija, por tu fe has quedado sana. Vete en paz».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Hija mía, tu fe te ha sanado y te ha salvado. Vete en paz».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Fille, ta foi t’a sauvée ; va en paix. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Ma fille, ta foi t’a guérie. Va en paix. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Ma fille, ta foi t’a guérie et sauvée. Va en paix. »

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Binti, imani yako imekuokoa; nenda kwa amani."
sw.B: Yesu alimwambia, "Binti, kwa imani yako umepona. Nenda kwa amani."
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Binti yangu, kwa sababu ya imani yako umepona na umeokolewa. Nenda kwa amani."

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 구원하였다. 평안히 가거라."
ko.B: 예수께서 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 낫게 하였다. 평안히 가거라."
ko.R: 예수께서 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "내 딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 낫게 하고 구원하였다. 평안히 가거라."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với bà: "Con gái, đức tin của con đã cứu con; hãy đi bình an."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với bà: "Con gái ơi, đức tin của con đã làm cho con được lành. Hãy đi bình an."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với bà: "Con gái ơi, đức tin của con đã chữa lành con và cứu con. Hãy về bình an."

decisions.choice: has saved you: has made you well, and more than that, has rescued you
decisions.reason: The verb means to save or rescue. In stories of healing it means to make well (8:36, 50; 17:19; 18:42). But Luke uses the same words, "your faith has saved you", to the woman whose sins were forgiven (7:50), where no healing took place. The woman's body has been healed (8:47); Jesus's words also welcome her and give her peace.

decisions.choice: your faith: her trust in Jesus, shown when she reached out to touch him
decisions.reason: It was not the cloak that healed her, but her trust in the one who wore it.

decisions.choice: go in peace: a blessing at parting
decisions.reason: The words are a Hebrew blessing (1 Samuel 1:17). Peace here means wholeness and well-being with God.

decisions.choice: Daughter: a tender way to address her
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to her as one of God's family, as he later calls a healed woman a daughter of Abraham (13:16).

decisions.choice: made you well (B); made you well and saved you (R)
decisions.reason: The verb covers both healing and rescue, as the meaning decision explains. Literal keeps "saved". Balanced says what happened to her body. Readable uses both words so that neither sense is lost.

decisions.choice: My daughter
decisions.reason: Readable adds "my" for the warmth of the address.

decisions.choice: te ha salvado (L); has quedado sana (B); te ha sanado y te ha salvado (R)
decisions.reason: The verb says she has been made well and, more than that, rescued (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "salvar"; Balanced says "made well" and Readable gives both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Fille (L); Ma fille (B, R)
alternatives: Fille at Balanced too, as the English "Daughter"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:34: Literal keeps the bare address, but in French "Fille" alone sounds curt, while "Ma fille" is the tender address the meaning decision describes (m4), so Balanced adds "Ma" as well as Readable.

decisions.choice: imekuokoa (L); umepona (B); umepona na umeokolewa (R)
decisions.reason: The verb says she has been made well and, more than that, rescued (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "kuokoa"; Balanced says "made well" and Readable gives both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "딸아" (L, B), "내 딸아" (R); "구원하였다" (L), "낫게 하였다" (B), "낫게 하고 구원하였다" (R); "평안히"
decisions.reason: The levels follow the English and the footnoted meaning decision; "평안" is the key term for peace from the Korean John, here in its adverb.

decisions.choice: Jesus calls her "con gái" and "con"; "đã cứu con" (L), "làm cho con được lành" (B), "chữa lành con và cứu con" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:34: "con" is how an older person speaks tenderly to someone younger, the warmth of "Daughter" (meaning decision); "ơi" at Balanced and Readable does the work of the English "My". The verb follows the English levels.

source.text: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἔρχεταί τις παρὰ τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου λέγων ὅτι Τέθνηκεν ἡ θυγάτηρ σου, μηκέτι σκύλλε τὸν διδάσκαλον.

records.literal_gloss: Still him speaking, comes someone from the synagogue ruler saying: Has died the daughter of you; no longer trouble the teacher.

en.L: While {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still speaking, someone came from the synagogue ruler's [house], saying, "Your daughter has died; do not trouble the Teacher any longer."
en.B: Jesus was still speaking when a messenger arrived from the synagogue ruler's house with the news, "Your daughter has died. There is no need to trouble the Teacher any further."
en.R: Jesus was still talking when someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. The messenger said to Jairus, "Your daughter has died. Do not bother the Teacher anymore."

es.L: Mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todavía hablaba, llegó alguien de [la casa] del jefe de la sinagoga, diciendo: «Tu hija ha muerto; no molestes más al Maestro».
es.B: Jesús todavía estaba hablando cuando llegó un mensajero de la casa del jefe de la sinagoga con la noticia: «Tu hija ha muerto. Ya no hace falta molestar más al Maestro».
es.R: Jesús todavía estaba hablando cuando llegó alguien de la casa de Jairo, el jefe de la sinagoga. Le dijo a Jairo: «Tu hija ha muerto. No molestes más al Maestro».

fr.L: Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlait encore, arrive quelqu’un de chez le chef de synagogue, disant : « Ta fille est morte ; ne dérange plus le maître. »
fr.B: Jésus parlait encore quand un messager arriva de chez le chef de synagogue et annonça : « Ta fille est morte. Ne dérange pas le maître davantage. »
fr.R: Jésus parlait encore quand quelqu’un est arrivé de la maison de Jaïre, le responsable de la synagogue. Il a dit à Jaïre : « Ta fille est morte. Ne dérange plus le maître. »

sw.L: Alipokuwa bado akisema, mtu fulani alikuja kutoka [nyumbani kwa] mkuu wa sinagogi, akisema, "Binti yako amekufa; usimsumbue Mwalimu tena."
sw.B: Yesu alipokuwa bado akizungumza, mjumbe alifika kutoka nyumbani kwa kiongozi wa sinagogi na kusema, "Binti yako amekufa. Hakuna haja ya kumsumbua Mwalimu tena."
sw.R: Yesu alipokuwa bado akiongea, mtu fulani alifika kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo, kiongozi wa sinagogi. Mjumbe huyo alimwambia Yairo, "Binti yako amekufa. Usimsumbue Mwalimu tena."

ko.L: 그분이 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 회당장의 [집]에서 어떤 사람이 와서 말한다. "따님이 죽었습니다. 이제 선생님을 더 수고롭게 하지 마십시오."
ko.B: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 회당장의 집에서 어떤 사람이 와서 말했다. "따님이 죽었습니다. 이제 선생님을 더 수고롭게 하실 필요가 없습니다."
ko.R: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때, 회당장 야이로의 집에서 어떤 사람이 왔다. 그가 야이로에게 말했다. "따님이 죽었습니다. 이제 선생님을 귀찮게 하지 마십시오."

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đang nói, có người từ [nhà] người lãnh đạo nhà hội đến, nói: "Con gái ông chết rồi; đừng làm phiền Thầy nữa."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu còn đang nói thì có người từ nhà ông lãnh đạo nhà hội đến báo tin: "Con gái ông chết rồi. Không cần làm phiền Thầy nữa."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu còn đang nói thì có một người từ nhà Giai-ru, ông lãnh đạo nhà hội, đến. Người ấy nói với Giai-ru: "Con gái ông đã chết rồi. Đừng làm phiền Thầy nữa."

decisions.choice: comes: a present tense in a story about the past
decisions.reason: The present tense makes the moment vivid: the news arrives while Jesus is still speaking to the woman.

decisions.choice: trouble: bother, put to more effort
decisions.reason: The messenger thinks that nothing more can be done now that the girl has died.

decisions.choice: the Teacher: a respectful title for Jesus
decisions.reason: People called a respected teacher of God's law "Teacher" (7:40).

decisions.choice: house
decisions.reason: The messenger came from Jairus's home, since Jairus himself was with Jesus.

decisions.choice: de chez le chef de synagogue, without a bracketed "[maison]"
alternatives: de [la maison du] chef de synagogue
decisions.reason: French "de chez" means "from the home of", so it gives the sense of the English supplied "[house]" without a bracket, as in Mark 5:35. Literal also keeps Luke's present "arrive".

decisions.choice: The messenger speaks to Jairus in 합쇼체, with "따님" for his daughter and "선생님" for the Teacher
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 5:35: he brings word to the synagogue leader, a superior, and speaks of Jesus with respect.

decisions.choice: "와서 말한다" (L) for Luke's present "comes"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the historic present (style guide, section 3); Balanced and Readable tell it in the past.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "the Teacher"; "đến" with no "đã" (L)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:35: the messenger speaks of Jesus by the respectful title. Literal leaves out "đã" to keep Luke's present "comes" (meaning decision).

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀκούσας ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ· Μὴ φοβοῦ, μόνον πίστευσον, καὶ σωθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: But Jesus having heard answered him: Not fear, only believe, and she will be saved.

en.L: But Jesus, having heard, answered him, "Do not fear; only believe, and she will be saved."
en.B: But Jesus heard it and answered Jairus, "Do not give way to fear. Only believe, and she will be made well."
en.R: When Jesus heard this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to Jairus, "Do not be afraid! Just believe, and your daughter will be made well."

es.L: Pero Jesús, al oír [esto], le respondió: «No temas; solo cree, y será salvada».
es.B: Pero Jesús lo oyó y le respondió a Jairo: «No te dejes vencer por el miedo. Solo cree, y ella quedará sana».
es.R: Cuando Jesús oyó esto, le dijo a Jairo: «¡No tengas miedo! Solo cree, y tu hija se sanará».

fr.L: Mais Jésus, ayant entendu, lui répondit : « Ne crains pas ; crois seulement, et elle sera sauvée. »
fr.B: Mais Jésus l’entendit et répondit à Jaïre : « Ne cède pas à la peur. Crois seulement, et elle sera guérie. »
fr.R: Quand Jésus a entendu cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit à Jaïre : « N’aie pas peur ! Crois seulement, et ta fille sera guérie. »

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, aliposikia, akamjibu, "Usiogope; amini tu, naye ataokoka."
sw.B: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, alimjibu Yairo, "Usikubali hofu ikushinde. Amini tu, naye atapona."
sw.R: Yesu aliposikia hayo, alimwambia Yairo, "Usiogope! Amini tu, na binti yako atapona."

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 들으시고 그에게 대답하셨다. "두려워하지 마라. 믿기만 하여라. 그러면 그 아이가 구원을 받을 것이다."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 이 말을 들으시고 야이로에게 말씀하셨다. "두려워하지 마라. 믿기만 하여라. 그러면 딸이 나을 것이다."
ko.R: 예수께서 이 말을 들으시고 야이로에게 말씀하셨다. "무서워하지 마라! 믿기만 해라. 그러면 네 딸이 다시 살아날 것이다."

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nghe được, thì trả lời ông: "Đừng sợ; chỉ hãy tin, và cô bé sẽ được cứu."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nghe vậy thì bảo Giai-ru: "Ông đừng sợ. Chỉ cần tin thôi, và cô bé sẽ được lành."
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu nghe vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với Giai-ru: "Ông đừng sợ! Chỉ cần tin thôi, con gái ông sẽ được lành."

decisions.choice: she will be saved: she will be rescued from death and made well
decisions.reason: The verb is the same as in 8:48. Here the girl has already died, and Jesus promises to bring her back to life and health.

decisions.choice: do not fear: stop being afraid
decisions.reason: The command calls him to stop the fear that the news has brought.

decisions.choice: only believe: trust now, in spite of the news
decisions.reason: The command asks Jairus to trust Jesus at the very moment when it seems too late. Faith links the two stories (8:48).

decisions.choice: she will be made well
decisions.reason: As in 8:48: Balanced and Readable say what Jesus promises for the girl; Literal keeps "saved".

decisions.choice: Jairus; your daughter (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the father, and Readable names the girl.

decisions.choice: "다시 살아날 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The girl is reported dead, and the meaning decision reads "saved" as rescued from death; "낫다" alone would sound odd of one who has died.

decisions.choice: Jesus says "ông" to Jairus (B, R); "cô bé" for the girl
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:36: a Vietnamese command to a respected older man sounds abrupt without a word of address; "cô bé" is the plain word for a young girl, used through 8:56.

source.text: ἐλθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν οὐκ ἀφῆκεν εἰσελθεῖν τινα σὺν αὐτῷ εἰ μὴ Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν πατέρα τῆς παιδὸς καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

records.literal_gloss: Having come then into the house, not he allowed to go in anyone with him except Peter and John and James and the father of the child and the mother.

en.L: And having come into the house, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not allow anyone to go in with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} except Peter and John and James, and the father of the child and the mother.
en.B: Arriving at the house, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} allowed only Peter, John and James, and the girl's father and mother, to go in with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus came to the house. He let only Peter, John, James, and the girl's parents go inside with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y llegando a la casa, no permitió a nadie entrar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, excepto a Pedro, a Juan y a Santiago, y al padre de la niña y a la madre.
es.B: Al llegar a la casa, solo dejó entrar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} a Pedro, a Juan y a Santiago, y al padre y a la madre de la niña.
es.R: Jesús llegó a la casa. Solo dejó que entraran con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} Pedro, Juan, Santiago y los padres de la niña.

fr.L: Et, arrivé à la maison, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissa personne entrer avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, sinon Pierre et Jean et Jacques, et le père de l’enfant et la mère.
fr.B: Arrivé à la maison, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissa entrer avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que Pierre, Jean et Jacques, avec le père et la mère de la fillette.
fr.R: Jésus est arrivé à la maison. Il a laissé entrer avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} seulement Pierre, Jean, Jacques et les parents de la fillette.

sw.L: Naye alipofika nyumbani, hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kuingia pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} isipokuwa Petro na Yohana na Yakobo, na baba wa mtoto na mama.
sw.B: Alipofika nyumbani, hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kuingia pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} isipokuwa Petro, Yohana na Yakobo, pamoja na baba na mama wa msichana.
sw.R: Yesu alifika nyumbani. Aliwaruhusu Petro, Yohana, Yakobo na wazazi wa msichana peke yao kuingia ndani pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.

ko.L: 그분은 그 집에 이르셔서, 베드로와 요한과 야고보와 그 아이의 아버지와 어머니 외에는 아무도 자기와 함께 들어가지 못하게 하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그 집에 이르셨을 때, 베드로와 요한과 야고보와 아이의 부모 외에는 아무도 함께 들어오지 못하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 야이로의 집에 오셨다. 예수께서는 베드로와 요한과 야고보, 그리고 아이의 부모만 함께 들어가게 하셨다.

vi.L: Khi đến nhà, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho ai vào với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ngoại trừ Phi-e-rơ, Giăng, và Gia-cơ, cùng cha và mẹ của đứa trẻ.
vi.B: Đến nhà, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ cho Phi-e-rơ, Giăng, Gia-cơ và cha mẹ cô bé vào với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đến nhà Giai-ru. Ngài chỉ cho Phi-e-rơ, Giăng, Gia-cơ và cha mẹ cô bé vào trong với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: to go in with him: into the room where the girl lay
decisions.reason: Mourners were already in the house (8:52-53). Mark 5:40 says Jesus put them out and went in where the child was.

decisions.choice: the child: the girl
decisions.reason: The word can mean a child or a servant. Here it is the daughter (8:42, 54).

decisions.choice: Peter, John and James: three disciples who are with Jesus at key moments
decisions.reason: The same three go up the mountain with him in 9:28, where Luke again names John before James.

decisions.choice: the girl's parents
alternatives: the father of the child and the mother
decisions.reason: Readable uses one word for both.

source.text: ἔκλαιον δὲ πάντες καὶ ἐκόπτοντο αὐτήν.

records.literal_gloss: Were weeping then all and mourning her.

en.L: And all were weeping and mourning for her.
en.B: Everyone was crying and wailing for her.
en.R: Everyone there was crying and grieving loudly for the girl.

es.L: Y todos lloraban y se lamentaban por ella.
es.B: Todos lloraban y daban gritos de dolor por ella.
es.R: Todos los que estaban allí lloraban y se lamentaban en voz alta por la niña.

fr.L: Et tous pleuraient et se lamentaient sur elle.
fr.B: Tous pleuraient et gémissaient sur elle.
fr.R: Tous les gens qui étaient là pleuraient et criaient très fort leur chagrin pour la fillette.

sw.L: Na wote walikuwa wakilia na kumwombolezea.
sw.B: Wote walikuwa wakilia na kumwombolezea kwa sauti.
sw.R: Watu wote waliokuwa pale walikuwa wakilia na kuomboleza kwa sauti kubwa kwa ajili ya msichana.

ko.L: 그리고 모두가 울며 그 아이를 위하여 가슴을 치고 있었다.
ko.B: 사람들은 모두 그 아이 때문에 울며 통곡하고 있었다.
ko.R: 거기 있던 사람들은 모두 그 아이 때문에 큰 소리로 울며 슬퍼하고 있었다.

vi.L: Và mọi người đều khóc lóc và đấm ngực than khóc cô bé.
vi.B: Mọi người đều đang khóc lóc than van cho cô bé.
vi.R: Mọi người ở đó đều khóc lóc và kêu than rất lớn vì cô bé.

decisions.choice: mourning: beating the breast in loud grief
decisions.reason: The verb means to beat oneself in grief. Mourning for the dead was loud and public, and sometimes mourners were hired (Jeremiah 9:17-18; Matthew 9:23).

decisions.choice: all: the people gathered at the house
decisions.reason: These are the mourners, not the five who went in with Jesus.

decisions.choice: "가슴을 치다" (L) for koptomai
decisions.reason: The verb pictures beating the breast in grief (meaning decision); Literal keeps the gesture, and Balanced and Readable say the loud mourning.

decisions.choice: "đấm ngực than khóc" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures beating the breast in loud grief (meaning decision); Literal shows the gesture, Balanced and Readable say the grief.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Μὴ κλαίετε, οὐ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν ἀλλὰ καθεύδει.

records.literal_gloss: But he said: Not weep, not for she died but sleeps.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Do not weep, for she did not die, but she is sleeping."
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them, "Do not weep. She has not died. She is sleeping."
en.R: But Jesus said, "Stop crying! She is not dead. She is only sleeping."

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «No {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}}, porque no murió, sino que duerme».
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «No {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}}. No ha muerto. Está dormida».
es.R: Pero Jesús dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de llorar! No está muerta. Solo está dormida».

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Ne pleurez pas, car elle n’est pas morte, mais elle dort. »
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Ne pleurez pas. Elle n’est pas morte, elle dort. »
fr.R: Mais Jésus a dit : « Arrêtez de pleurer ! Elle n’est pas morte. Elle dort seulement. »

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akasema, "Msilie, kwa maana hakufa, bali amelala."
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliwaambia, "Msilie. Hajafa. Amelala."
sw.R: Lakini Yesu alisema, "Acheni kulia! Hajafa. Amelala tu."

ko.L: 그러나 그분이 말씀하셨다. "울지 마라. 그 아이는 죽은 것이 아니라 자고 있다."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "울지 마라. 아이는 죽은 것이 아니라 잠들어 있다."
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "그만 울어라! 아이는 죽지 않았다. 그냥 자고 있을 뿐이다."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Đừng khóc, vì cô bé không chết, nhưng đang ngủ."
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo họ: "Đừng khóc nữa. Cô bé không chết đâu; cô bé đang ngủ."
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói: "Đừng khóc nữa! Cô bé không chết đâu. Cô bé chỉ đang ngủ thôi."

decisions.choice: she did not die but is sleeping: her death is like a sleep from which Jesus will wake her
decisions.reason: Luke says plainly that she had died (8:49, 53, 55). Jesus speaks of death as sleep because he is about to wake her, as with Lazarus (John 11:11-14). Scripture often speaks of death as sleep (Daniel 12:2; 1 Thessalonians 4:13).

decisions.choice: do not weep: stop weeping
decisions.reason: The command tells them to stop the weeping already going on.

decisions.choice: only
decisions.reason: Readable adds "only" to bring out the contrast with death.

decisions.choice: "đang ngủ" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:39 and Matthew 9:24: Jesus speaks of her death as a sleep (meaning decision), so the plain word keeps the picture.

source.text: καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ, εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπέθανεν.

records.literal_gloss: And they were laughing at him, knowing that she died.

en.L: And they were laughing at {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, knowing that she had died.
en.B: They ridiculed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, since they knew that she had died.
en.R: They laughed at Jesus, because they knew the girl was dead.

es.L: Y se burlaban de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, sabiendo que había muerto.
es.B: Se reían de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con desprecio, porque sabían que había muerto.
es.R: Se rieron de Jesús, porque sabían que la niña estaba muerta.

fr.L: Et ils se moquaient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, sachant qu’elle était morte.
fr.B: Ils se moquèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, car ils savaient qu’elle était morte.
