fr.R: Les gens se sont moqués de Jésus, parce qu’ils savaient que la fillette était morte.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wakimcheka, wakijua kwamba amekufa.
sw.B: Walimcheka kwa dharau, kwa kuwa walijua kwamba amekufa.
sw.R: Walimcheka Yesu, kwa sababu walijua kwamba msichana amekufa.

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 그 아이가 죽은 것을 알고 있었으므로 그분을 비웃고 있었다.
ko.B: 사람들은 아이가 죽은 것을 알고 있었으므로 예수를 비웃었다.
ko.R: 사람들은 예수를 보고 비웃었다. 아이가 죽은 것을 알고 있었기 때문이다.

vi.L: Và họ chế nhạo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì biết cô bé đã chết.
vi.B: Họ cười nhạo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì biết chắc cô bé đã chết.
vi.R: Mọi người cười nhạo Đức Giê-xu, vì họ biết cô bé đã chết rồi.

decisions.choice: laughing at: mocking, laughing with scorn
decisions.reason: The verb means to laugh someone down. They think Jesus's words are foolish.

decisions.choice: knowing that she had died: they were certain
decisions.reason: Their scorn confirms that the girl had truly died. Jesus is about to raise the dead (7:22).

source.text: αὐτὸς δὲ κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς ἐφώνησεν λέγων· Ἡ παῖς, ἔγειρε.

records.literal_gloss: But he having taken hold of the hand of her called out saying: The child, arise.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, taking hold of her hand, called out, saying, "Child, arise!"
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took hold of her hand and called, "Child, get up!"
en.R: But Jesus took the girl's hand and called out, "Child, get up!"

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, tomándola de la mano, la llamó, diciendo: «¡Niña, levántate!».
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la tomó de la mano y la llamó: «¡Niña, levántate!».
es.R: Pero Jesús tomó la mano de la niña y le dijo en voz alta: «¡Niña, levántate!».

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, saisissant sa main, appela, disant : « Enfant, lève-toi ! »
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui prit la main et l’appela : « Enfant, lève-toi ! »
fr.R: Mais Jésus a pris la main de la fillette et il a dit d’une voix forte : « Mon enfant, lève-toi ! »

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, akiushika mkono wake, aliita, akisema, "Mtoto, amka!"
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alimshika mkono, akaita, "Mtoto, amka!"
sw.R: Lakini Yesu aliushika mkono wa msichana, akaita kwa sauti, "Mtoto, amka!"

ko.L: 그러나 그분은 그 아이의 손을 잡으시고 큰 소리로 말씀하셨다. "아이야, 일어나라."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서는 아이의 손을 잡으시고 큰 소리로 말씀하셨다. "아이야, 일어나라!"
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서는 아이의 손을 잡으시고 큰 소리로 말씀하셨다. "얘야, 일어나라!"

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nắm lấy tay cô bé, gọi lớn rằng: "Hỡi con, hãy trỗi dậy!"
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nắm tay cô bé và gọi: "Con ơi, hãy trỗi dậy!"
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu cầm tay cô bé và gọi lớn: "Con ơi, hãy đứng dậy!"

decisions.choice: But he, taking hold: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: But he, having put them all outside and taking hold, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add that he put everyone outside, which matches Mark 5:40. Early manuscripts lack the words. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: arise: get up, rise
decisions.reason: The verb is used for getting up and for being raised from the dead (7:14, 22; 9:22).

decisions.choice: taking hold of her hand: touching the dead
decisions.reason: Touching a dead body made a person unclean (Numbers 19:11). Jesus touches the dead girl, as he touched the bier of the widow's son (7:14), and gives life.

decisions.choice: amka (get up, wake)
decisions.reason: The verb is also used of rising from death (meaning decision m2). "Kuamka" is to get up and to wake, which answers Jesus's "amelala" in verse 52, as in Mark 5:41; "simama" (stand up) loses that.

decisions.choice: "아이야" (L, B); "얘야" (R) for pais
decisions.reason: Luke's word is the general word for a child; Readable uses the warm everyday form, as the Korean Mark does.

decisions.choice: "trỗi dậy" (L, B); "đứng dậy" (R); "con" for the child
decisions.reason: As in Mark 5:41: "trỗi dậy" carries both getting up and rising (meaning decision), and Readable uses the everyday word. Luke's word is "child", so Jesus says the tender "con".

source.text: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀνέστη παραχρῆμα, καὶ διέταξεν αὐτῇ δοθῆναι φαγεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: And returned the spirit of her, and she rose up immediately, and he directed to her to be given to eat.

en.L: And her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} directed that [something] be given to her to eat.
en.B: Her spirit came back to her, and she rose at once, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave orders that she be given food.
en.R: Her life came back into her, and she got up right away. Jesus told them to give her some food.

es.L: Y volvió su espíritu, y se levantó al instante, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mandó que se le diera de comer.
es.B: Su espíritu volvió a ella, y se levantó en el acto. Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ordenó que le dieran de comer.
es.R: La niña volvió a la vida y se levantó enseguida. Jesús les dijo que le dieran algo de comer.

fr.L: Et son esprit revint, et elle se leva à l’instant, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ordonna qu’on lui donne à manger.
fr.B: Son esprit revint en elle ; elle se leva aussitôt, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demanda qu’on lui donne à manger.
fr.R: La vie est revenue en elle, et elle s’est levée tout de suite. Jésus a dit de lui donner quelque chose à manger.

sw.L: Na roho yake ikarudi, naye akasimama mara moja, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaagiza apewe [kitu] cha kula.
sw.B: Roho yake ilimrudia, akaamka papo hapo, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaagiza apewe chakula.
sw.R: Uhai ulimrudia, akaamka mara moja. Yesu aliwaambia wampe chakula.

ko.L: 그러자 그 아이의 영이 돌아왔고, 아이가 곧 일어났다. 그리고 그분은 그 아이에게 먹을 것을 주라고 지시하셨다.
ko.B: 그러자 아이의 영이 돌아와서 아이가 곧바로 일어났다. 예수께서는 아이에게 먹을 것을 주라고 이르셨다.
ko.R: 그러자 아이에게 생명이 다시 돌아왔다. 아이는 바로 일어났다. 예수께서는 사람들에게 아이에게 먹을 것을 주라고 말씀하셨다.

vi.L: Và linh hồn cô bé trở lại, và cô bé đứng dậy lập tức, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền cho [người ta] đem [đồ] cho cô bé ăn.
vi.B: Linh hồn cô bé trở lại, cô bé liền đứng dậy, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo họ đem đồ ăn cho cô bé.
vi.R: Sự sống trở lại với cô bé, và cô bé đứng dậy ngay. Đức Giê-xu bảo họ cho cô bé ăn.

decisions.choice: her spirit: her breath of life
decisions.reason: The word means spirit or breath. Her life returned to her body.

decisions.choice: her spirit returned: as when Elijah raised the widow's son
decisions.reason: When Elijah prayed, the boy's life came back into him and he lived (1 Kings 17:21-22). Luke has already linked Jesus with Elijah's miracle (4:25-26; 7:15).

decisions.choice: something to eat: proof that she was truly alive and well
decisions.reason: She is not a ghost or half alive. She can eat, as the risen Jesus will (24:41-43).

decisions.choice: Her life
decisions.reason: Readable says what "spirit" means here, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "영" (L, B); "생명" (R) for pneuma
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads her spirit as her breath of life; Literal and Balanced keep "영", Readable says "생명", as the English Readable says "life". "생명" is the Korean John's word for zōē, so it stays at Readable only.

decisions.choice: "linh hồn" (L, B); "sự sống" (R) for her spirit
decisions.reason: The meaning decision gives her breath of life; "linh hồn" is the ordinary word for the life-giving spirit that leaves at death and returns here, and Readable says "life", as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτῆς· ὁ δὲ παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς μηδενὶ εἰπεῖν τὸ γεγονός.

records.literal_gloss: And were amazed the parents of her; but he instructed them no one to tell the [thing] having happened.

en.L: And her parents were amazed; but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} instructed them to tell no one what had happened.
en.B: Her parents were beside themselves with amazement. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} charged them to keep what had happened to themselves.
en.R: Her parents were so amazed! But Jesus ordered them to keep it to themselves. They were not to tell anyone about it.

es.L: Y sus padres quedaron asombrados; pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les ordenó que no dijeran a nadie lo que había sucedido.
es.B: Sus padres quedaron fuera de sí de asombro. Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les mandó que no contaran a nadie lo que había pasado.
es.R: ¡Sus padres estaban muy asombrados! Pero Jesús les ordenó que se lo guardaran para ellos. No debían contárselo a nadie.

fr.L: Et ses parents furent stupéfaits ; mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ordonna de ne dire à personne ce qui était arrivé.
fr.B: Ses parents étaient hors d’eux-mêmes de stupeur. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur recommanda de garder pour eux ce qui s’était passé.
fr.R: Ses parents étaient tellement étonnés ! Mais Jésus leur a ordonné de garder cela pour eux. Ils ne devaient en parler à personne.

sw.L: Na wazazi wake wakastaajabu; lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akawaagiza wasimwambie mtu yeyote kilichotokea.
sw.B: Wazazi wake walishangaa kupita kiasi. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliwaagiza wasimweleze mtu yeyote yaliyotokea.
sw.R: Wazazi wake walishangaa sana! Lakini Yesu aliwaagiza wasiseme habari hiyo. Hawakupaswa kumwambia mtu yeyote.

ko.L: 그러자 그 아이의 부모가 크게 놀랐다. 그러나 그분은 일어난 일을 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 그들에게 명령하셨다.
ko.B: 아이의 부모는 너무 놀라 어쩔 줄을 몰랐다. 그러나 예수께서는 일어난 일을 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 그들에게 단단히 이르셨다.
ko.R: 아이의 부모는 너무나 놀랐다. 그러나 예수께서는 그들에게 이 일을 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 명령하셨다.

vi.L: Và cha mẹ cô bé kinh ngạc; nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dặn họ đừng nói với ai việc đã xảy ra.
vi.B: Cha mẹ cô bé vô cùng sửng sốt. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền cho họ không được kể cho ai biết việc đã xảy ra.
vi.R: Cha mẹ cô bé vô cùng kinh ngạc! Nhưng Đức Giê-xu dặn họ giữ kín việc này. Họ không được kể cho ai biết.

decisions.choice: were amazed: were astonished, beside themselves
decisions.reason: The verb means to be out of one's mind with wonder.

decisions.choice: to tell no one: a command Luke gives without a reason
alternatives: a command to lie about it
decisions.reason: Jesus gave similar orders after other healings and about who he was (5:14; 9:21). Luke does not explain the order here.
